1480: Haelohim asher netanah. vechaved makriv leh legabbeh lev, deihu sannegora aleh, vecholla kishshura kachada bekurebna.

Min kaved, nafkin kol marin, vechol machteshin, lechol shayyfe gufa, uveh sharyayn. lev, ihu zachich mikkolla. minneh nafkin kol tav, vechol beriuta deshayyfin kullehu, vechol tukepa, vechol chedva, vechol shelimu deitzterich lechol shayyfin.

Laydod, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem. bechovin dilhon mitparde atvavn, vetikkuna (sefer acher dilhon hu orayyta), hu delehevi orayyta deihu shem yedod, lekarva atvavn, 10 baAdonai, 6 baAdonai, bekarbena dilhon.

Hare bechol karbenin, ben divire, ben demalachin dimmanan al pikudin, ben bemalchuta, ben bishmeh. kolla tzarich lekarva lekudesha berich hu (deorayyta dileh) beatvavn kaddishin. veihu rachiv bearba chevan demalachim. veihu rachiv bearba yesodin, deminnehon itberiu arba chevan tiviyyim. veihu hu dimkarev mayya beeshsha, verucha beafra. hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 25:2) ose shalom bimromav. veof hachi hu mekarev michael deihu mayim sichliyyim, im gavriel. dehu esh sichli. veihu mekarev uriel, deihu avvir. dehayynu ruach sichli. im refael, deihu efer, dehayynu afar sichlit. demiyyad deistallak kudesha berich hu mibbenayyhu, let behon chela.

Vei tema, ha ketiv bechol karbenin laydod, veech amarna deit piruda beatvavn. ella hay ittemar, bedargin deitberiu veitkeriu bishmeh. vela deinnun ihu mammash. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 43:7) kol hanikra vishmi velichvodi berativ yetztzartiv af asitiv. deit atvavn daydod baatztzilut, delet behon piruda vehafesaka, deinnun kemabbuin legabbayyhu, deashkeyyayn leilanin. uvegin illen deitberiu, idamyayn 10 leresha, 6 legufa, Adonai Adonai leeser etztzeban.

Aval illot haillot al kolla, deitkere Adonai, ittemar beh, (Yeshayahu 40:25) veel mi tedammeyuni veeshve yomar kadosh. (Yeshayahu 40:18) veel mi tedammeyun el uma demut taarchu lo. (Malachi 3:6) ani Adonai lo shaniti. la mate beh chovin leafresha atvoy, 10 meAdonai, 6 meAdonai, delet beh piruda. vealeh ittemar, (Tehillim Adonai:Adonai) lo yegurecha ra. ihu shallit al kolla, velet man deshalit beh. ihu tafis becholla, velet man detafis beh. veihu la itkere Adonai, uvechol shemahan, ella beitpashshetut nehoreh alayyhu. vechad istelik minnayyhu, let leh miggarmeh shem kelal minnehon. (Kohelet 7:24) amok amok mi yimtztzaennu.

Let nehora yachil leistakkela beh, dela itchashshechat. afillu keter elyon, deihu nehoreh takkif al kol dargin, veal kol chele shemaya, illain vetattain, ittemar aleh, (Tehillim 18:12) yashet choshech sitro. veal chachma uvina, (Tehillim 97:2) anan vaarafel sevivav. kol shekken shear sefiran. kol shekken chevan. kol shekken yesodin, deinnun metim. ihu sovev al kol almin, velet sovev lon lechol sitra, ella vetatta, ulearba sitrin, bar mineh. velet man denafik mershuteh levar. ihu memale kol almin. velet (sefer acher elaha vechulei lon bar minneh) ochara memale lon.

Ihu mechayye lon velet aleh elaha achara, lemehav leh chayyin. hada hu dichtiv, (Nechemya 9:6) veatta mechayye et kulam. uvegineh amor daniel, (Daniel 4:32) vechol deare ara kella chashivin uchemitztzebyeh avid bechel shemaya. ihu mekashsher umeyached zina lezineh, ella vetatta. velet kureva lehu bed yesodin, ella kudesha berich hu kad ihu benayyhu.

Miyyad dechavu, illen deitkeriu banim attem laydod elokechem, istellak min atvavn, ishtearu beferuda. umay tikkuneh, lekarva atvavn bekudesha berich hu, 10 baAdonai, 6 baAdonai. uf hachi innun avdin dileh, missitra dechevan. bechovin dilhon garmu leh, leistalleka minnehon. may takanta dilhon. lenachta kudesha berich hu alayyhu, lekarva lon. uf hachi innun dahavo mearba yesodin, deinnun ana dekudesha berich hu, degarmu lesalleka kudesha berich hu minnayyhu. may takna. lekarva lon lekudesha berich hu.

Uvegin da bechullehu mane, karban laydod, et karbani lachmi leishshay. uf et hakkeves echad taase vabboker veet hakkeves hashsheni taase ben haarbayim. uchetiv (velakachta) (Vayikra Adonai:7) shete torim o shene vene yona, kol zina azil lezineh. vekudesha berich hu mekarev kolla baatar da, ihu illat al kolla, delet elaha bar minneh. velet man deyachil lekarva chelin, bar minneh.

Aval chelin deumin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, innun missitra deferuda. vavy leman degarim bechovoy, leaala atvavn vechevan visodin. demiyyad istallak kudesha berich hu miyisrael. veyialun umin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot benayyhu. let lon kerivut bekudesha berich hu, delet korbenin bechutztza laaretz. uvegin da ukemuha rabbanan, haddar bechutztza laaretz dome kemi sheen lo eloah. behahu zimna deamar millin illen, nachtu kol atvavn kaddishin, vechevan kaddishin, ved yesodin, legabbeh, uvarichu leh veamru, al yedach raya mehemana, nachit alan kudesha berich hu, umitkarvin zina
1481: Lezineh, berich ant lekudesha berich hu, bearba yesodin. kean itberir kolla al bureyeh. (ad kan raya mehemana) (uvechibbura kadmaa keva 234 amud bet)

Patach veamar, (tehillim lo) betach baAdonai vaase tov shechan eretz uree emuna. betach baAdonai, kaddeka yaut. vaase tov, tikkuna divrit kaddisha. dittehe metakken leh, venatir leh kaddeka yaut. vei taavid da, ant tehe hacha beara, veyittezan minach, veyitparnes minach, hahi emuna dilella.

Vetu, (sefer acher metakken leh venatir leh. shekken eretz eretz kaddisha ilaa eretz hachayyim dehahi eretz tishre behahu tov. veraa emuna hahi emuna dilella yittezan veyitparnes minneh al yadcha. vei taaved da) titannag al Adonai veyitten lecha mishalot libbecha. kol da ittekanat betikkuna divrit. kevan deittakanat berit, ittekan kolla. pinchas begin dekanne al berit da, zacha lecholla. velo od ella deagin al kol yisrael, uveh itkayyaym vehitannag al Adonai. deha salik veitkeshar leella, (veanhir) beor kadmaa devara kudesha berich hu, veganiz leh. behahu or deithane avraham minneh, veaharon kahana itkeshar beh.

Levatar deistallak lechahana rabba, la adkar leh katlanuta dezimri, vela yaut begin dela yitachad kelal beanpoy desitra achara, vela itchaze leadkera aleh. dechol man dekatil, anfin desitra ochora it beh. ufinchas ha mitachid bimina, velet leh chulak besitra ochora kelal, veal da la adkar hacha. ma deitchaze shevacha, ihu genay leh, unechitu middarga illaa deitachid beh. veal da ketiv hammukke asher hukka setam, veshem haisha hammukka, vela adkar al yeda deman.

Amar ribbi pinchas, zakkaa dara deshamin milach beorayyta, vezakkaa chulaki dezachena lechach. amar ribbi shimon, zakkaa dara, deant vachasidutach ishtechach begavvivy. ad dahavo yatvin umefayysin da leda, ata ribbi elazar bereh derabbi shimon, veashkach lon tamman. amar ribbi pinchas, vadday dichtiv, (Bereshit 32:3) vayyomer yaakov kaasher raam machane elohim ze. amar leh rabbi shimon, elazar beri, tiv beri, veema kera. yativ ribbi elazar.

Patach veamar, (Bereshit 32:2) veyaakov halach ledarko vayyifgeu vo malache elohim. may vayyifgeu bo. ella it pegia letav. veit pegia levish. veit pegia litzlota. ella beshaata dehava azil lecharan, ma ketiv. (Bereshit 28:11) vayyifga bammakom, tzelota dearvit hava detzalle behahu makom. kema deat amer, (Shemot 33:21) hinne makom itti. utzelota dearvit behahu atar itchaze.

Tu vayyifga bammakom, mille piyyusin ihu. deata shimsha kaddisha legabbe sihara, balah legabbe itteta. mikkan dela yeot labbaal lemete legabbe itteta, i la havi bemille piyyusin lefayyeysa lah. dichtiv vayyifga bammakom, ulevatar vayyalen sham. kad hava ate yaakov mecharan, ma ketiv, vayyifgeu vo, shadrat hi lefayyeysa leh, lemete legabbah.

Vayyomer yaakov kaasher raam. may kaasher raam. illen malachin deyom, umalachin delayla havo, veitkesiu minneh, ulevatar itgalleyayn leh. veal da kaasher raam, ketiv machane elohim ze. mehacha dahavo illen dimama, veillen delelya. innun delelya ketiv behu,

Raya mehemna ella pegia ihi piyyusa, dechad yite chatan legabbe kalla, let orach lechatan leyaychada bechalla, ella befiyyusa. ulevatar yabed immah lina. vehayeynu (davar acher vayyalen sham) ki va hashshemesh.

Amar raya mehemana, i hachi may nihu ki va hashshemesh deha orach derasha ukemuha, leshon keviyyay, vehayeynu ki va hashshemesh. ella mehacha olifna, man dimyayched beitteteh, tzarich belelya lemichbe sheraga, uvimama lav orach derabbanan leshammesh mitatan, ella ballayla, orach tzina. uvegin da, matay itavid lina. ki va hashshemesh, deitpene shimsha mealma.

Uvegin da, uf hachi detztzarich leitkasseyay min shimsha, vehachi tzarich leitkasseyay meillen malachin, deinnun miyyitztzer hatov mimina, bechamma mashiryayn. umiyitztzer hara, deazil lismala bechamma mashiryayn. uvegin da, batar deata tzafra, amar kaasher raam. umissitra deyaakov dehava ish tam, la hava immeh ella chayyaylin demalka umatronita. uvegin da vayyikra shem hammakom hahu machanayim. innun malachin dimama ketiv. kaasher raam machane elohim ze. vechad atu malachim delelya, deitkenashu bahadeh, lenatra leh amar vayyikra
1482: Machane elohim, veinnun dimama, ketiv behu, ze. veal da vayyikra shem hammakom hahu machanayim. teren mashiryayn. vehashsheta mashiryayn kaddishin chamena hacha. zakkaa archi daatena hacha.

Begin ditztzelota ihi kalla, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 4:8) itti millevanon kalla itti vegomer. itkere hacha itti. uveorayyta devichtav ittemar alah, (Shemot 33:21) hinne makom itti. uvegin deihi itkeriat makom bealma den, ittemar bah vayyifga bammakom vayyalen sham.

Uvegin da ihi amrat, (Yirmeyahu 9:1) mi yitteneni vammidbar melon orchim. dahavat reshu bifne atztzemah, velav im innun dekavin lah chova immehon, bela chatan dilah. uvechol shaata debar nash metztzalle, kudesha berich hu akdim venatar leh. veraza demilla, (Bereshit 24:21) vehaish mishtae lah. velet ish, ella kudesha berich hu. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 15:3) Adonai ish milchama. (Bereshit 24:15) vayhi hu terem kila ledabber vehinne rivka yotztzet, kegon (Zecharya 9:14) veyatztza kabbarak chitztzo.

Vei temrun, deha ukemuha rabbanan, leasra kadma shechinta veatya, leechad ad deyitiv. leasra dehi 10 kadma Adonai. leechad deihu 6, ad deyativ, la atya legabbeh Adonai tinyayna. veraza demilla, devaatar delet tamman yah, la atya tamman Adonai. uman devae leyachada atvavn, tzarich bitchinna uvetachanune. uvegin da, (Devarim 3:23) vaetchannan el Adonai, baadonay lishchi ynta betachanunim. ullekudesha berich hu berachame, ad hacha.

Et hakkeves haechad taase vabboker veet hakkeves hashsheni taase ben haarbayim. deihu raza dechavshe derachamana, deokmuha alayyhu rabbanan, gabbe kavshe derachamana lamma lach. ella millin dihon techot kivshone dealma, yihon mechusin techot levushach. ma levush ihu mechasse al gufa, uf hachi tzarich lechassaa razin deorayyta. kol shekken razin dekarbenin, deinnun kegavvna dikrivu deitteta legabbe balah.

Uma kerivu detarvavyyhu tzarich beitkasseya. uf hachi tzarich karban lechassaa lon, mibbene aryayn rashiayyay chatztzufin, delet lon boshet panim vela anava. vechamma mine mamzerin innun, bene arayot, bene nidda, denad Adonai minnah, veishtechach beatrah. shifcha bat el nechar zona. vehay ihu raza, (Mishlei 30:22) tachat shalosh ragza eretz vegomer, tachat eved ki yimloch venaval ki yisba lachem veshifcha ki tirash gevirtah. denad Adonai meatraa, deihi matronita, yetztzer hatov. veala beatraha shifcha yetztzer hara.

Veraza demilla, (Vayikra 14:35) kenega nira li babbayit, hayeynu dam tame denidda. uma hatam vehisgiro hakkohen shivat yamim. uf hachi (Vayikra 15:19) shivat yamim tihye veniddatah. (velet metzora vechulei ad laAdonai elohechem nidpas befarashat tzav daf 33 amud bet) zakkain innun evarim demitkaddeshe beshaat tashmish, deinnun atztze

Amar rabbi shimon, man defatach pitcha yemma. amar ribbi elazar, tanenan, kol man deamar tehilla ledavid bechol yom telat zimnin, ihu bar alma deate. veha ittemar taama. i begin parnasa umezona dechol almin, teren zimnin innun bechol yoma betzafra uvefanyay, dichtiv, (Shemot 15) betet Adonai lachem baerev basar vegomer, amay telat zimnin bechol yoma. ella teren limzona divne inshe udechol alma. vechad lemehav tukepa lehahu atar diftichu yedoy.

Uteren mezonin illen meshanyayn da min da, vechullehu telat mezone ketive hacha, (Tehillim 145:15) veatta noten lahem et achlam veitto, da mezona daatire, deyahiv mechla saggi beitto, ha chad. teren, dichtiv umasbia lechol chay ratzon, da mezona demiskene, deinnun sevein meratzon, vela miggo mechla saggi. telat dichtiv poteach et yadecha, da tukepa lehahu atar, veviftichu deyadoy, nafka ratzon vesava lecholla.

Tu hachi olifna, dela ihu ella tere zimne, begin mezona ufarnasa bechol yoma. deillen chiyyuva al bar nash. vei amar yattir, lav begin chova ihu, ella begin shevacha go tushebchan dizmirot dedavid malka. (sefer acher denafik yedoy dekudesha berich hu uvarich leshiva mertzon veal da lav chiyyuva hu ella tere zimne beyoma ushevacha ihu lekudesha berich hu latet lo zemirot dedavid malka) may tama. begin defarnasa la chaze lemishal ella batar tzelota ufarnasa demareh. malka yechul bekadmita ulevatar yechlun avdoy.

Hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:1) bati leganni achoti challa achalti yari im divshi shatiti yeni im chalavi, levatar ichlu reim. achalti yari, da tzelota dimyushav. im divshi da keriat shema. achalti yari da tzelota dimyushav, hahu yaar
1483: Haola, daachidan behon eshshin kaddishin, shem yedod deachid beeshin dilhon. uvegin da (Yeshayahu 24:15) baurim kabbedu Adonai al ken kivshe derachamana, hayeynu et hakkeves haechad taase vabboker veet hakkeves hashsheni taase ben haarbayim.

Shelimu dikra, vaasirit haefa solet. zakkaa ihu man deangid mimocheh, tippa solet nekiyya bela pesolet. veihi remiza beat 10 min adonay, kelila beeser sefiran. deihi belula beshemen katit reviit hahin. veihi belula, vammikra, bammishna, battalmud, bekabbala. (kan shayych ma shekkatuv baddaf 244 amud alef amar raya mehemana vaasirit haefa)

Yechezkel kad chama shechinta miggo kelippin, chaza immah eser sefiran. bela piruda kelal. veillen innun mocha, millego, kullehu chaza lon miggo nehar kevar diltatta, ihi (Tehillim 68:18) rechev elohim ribbotayim, kol ribbo eser alfin, ribbotayim 20 elef, appik tere sheenan, ishtaaru timne sar, bechusheban 18 almin. dechalil eser sefiran, deitlabbash betet min metatron. tet min totafot, veittemar beh (Devarim 6:8) vehayu letotafot ben enecha. man ayynin. illen leella, deittemar behu (Yechezkel 1:1) niftechu hashshamayim vaere marot elohim. man marot. illen innun asara marot dimtatron, dechaza kishraga bego ashishita. tesha beitgalyay, vechad satim.

Mara chada deihu chezu kadmaa meellu asara, da ihu deittemar beh, (Yechezkel 1:26) umimmaal larakia asher al rosham kemare even sappir demut kisse. veaf al gav deitperash leella, tzarich lechadta aleh millin dechiddushin.

Amar kudesha berich hu, lemashiryayn dilella, man dimtztzale, ben yehe gibbor, ben yehe chacham, ben yehe ashir. bezachvavn gibbor. chacham battora. veashir bammitztzevot. la yiul behechala da tzeloteh, ad detichzun beh simanin illen, deyahav garmeh beh tikkunin dili. uvegin da okmuha mare matnitin, im harav dome lemalach Adonai tzevaot tora yevakshu mifihu. leman diyhe rashim beillen simanin bilvusheh, tekabbelun tzeloteh. simana chada diyhe rashim bitztzeloteh, bitchelet, bechanfe mitztzeva tzitztzit. deihu dame larakia, deihu metatron. diyyukena dileh, techelet shebbatztzitztzit.

Uvegin da, shiur hatztzitztzit okmuha rabbanan, talit shehakatan mitkasa bah rosho verubbo. vehay ihu deittemar beh, (Yeshayahu 11:6) venaar katon noheg bam. vehay ihu noheg bed chevan, deinnun 4, veihu kalil (Melachim 1 10:19) shesh maalot lachisse, deinnun 6. uvegin deihu kalil eser, mitlabbeshin beh eser sefiran, 10. uveh hava itchazi kudesha berich hu bishchinte, deihi kelila meeser sefiran, linvie. umissitra dishchinta deihi ashiraa, techelet shebbatztzitztzit, ihu techelet dechol gavvnin.

Deihi tachlit dey sefiran. uveh (Shemot 39:32) vattechel kol avodat ohel moed. veihi lashon kalla. hada hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 7:1) vayhi beyom kallot moshe lehakim et hammishkan. veokmuha rabbanan, kallat ketiv, veihu techelet dishraga, deachil teravin veillavavn.

Vealeh amar yechezkel (Yechezkel 1:26) demut kemare even sappir demut kisse. segula dehay even, man deyarit lah, la shalta nura degehinnam aleh. let nura bealma mekalkel lah, vela kol mine mattechot. kol shekken mayya, dela mazziku lah. man deyarit lah, itkayyaym beh (Yeshayahu 43:2) ki taavor bammayim ittecha ani vegomer. vechol illain vetattain desitra achara dachalin minneh. techelet deyamma begineh ittemar, ki taavor bammayim ittecha ani. devisgula da, (Shemot 15:1) sus verochvo rama vayyam, da memana demitztzerayim.

Miggavvn da, dachalin illain vetattain. mashiryayn deyamma dachalin minneh. umashiryayn dirkia deihu techelet, minneh dachalin. mashiryayn ditchelet (sefer acher umashshiryayn darekayayn umashshiryayn) denura degehinnam dachalin minneh.
Vehay techelet

Levanon, yotzer or (sefer acher meshartim) vehaofannim vechayyot hakkodesh, (kullam kedoshim) kol hane ikrun yaar ilanin unetzivin deveh. im divshi da keriat shema, deihu metiku decholla, bechamma tzufin umetikin.

Shatiti yeni, da tzelota, dimumad, metivu (sefer acher meshichu) deyena illaa deitnetar. veda beshalosh berachot rishonot. im chalavi, illen innun shalosh berachot acharonot, veitkelilan illen beillen. ad kaon mechla demalka. levatar deachal malka, ichlu reim leella, shetu veshichru dodim letatta.

Veal da let chiyyuva dimzona ella levatar tzelota. bitzlota demincha (beerev) kodem tzelota may tama. begin dead la ishtechach dina kashya, beod deanpin demalka nehirin, yemma tehilla ledavid, behay siddura dimzona. dilvatar dedina sharya vetale al alma, lav shaata ihu. ata ribbi pinchas uneshakeh.

Amar ribbi yehuda, lema lan mor, (sefer acher meillen) millin mealleyata derosh hashshana. patach ribbi shimon veamar (Melachim 2 4:8) vayhi hayyom. bechol atar dichtiv vayhi, ihu tzaar, vayhi bime tzaar. vaday, vayhi hayyom, yoma deit beh tzaar, veda hu rosh hashshana, yoma deit beh dina kashya al alma. vayhi hayyom vayyaavor elisha el shunem, yoma derosh hashshana hava. uvechol atar vayhi hayyom, da rosh hashshana. (Iyov 1:6) vayhi hayyom vayavou bene haelohim, yom rosh hashshana hava.

Bechol zimna teren yomin innun, may taama. begin, delihevi yitzchak kalil dina verachame, teren yomin vela chad. deilmale yishtechach yechiday, yachariv alma. veal da ketiv teren zimnin, vayhi hayyom vayhi hayyom.

Vayavou bene haelohim, illen bet din ravreva. bene haelohim vadday, benoy demalka kerivin legabbeh. veinnun shivin memanan, desacharin tedira lemalka. veinnun chatchin dina al alma. lehityatztzev al Adonai, vechi al Adonai kayyme. ella, beshaata deillen kayyme al dina, dina kadmaa decholla beh, man hu. dela yokir lishma dekudesha berich hu, udela yokir leorayyta uleavdoy. uf hachi, man hu dela chayish al yekara dishma kadisha, dela yitchallel beara. man hu dela chayish likareh dekudesha berich hu, man hu dela shavvi yekar lishma da. vayyavo gam hassatan betocham, gam, lerabbot hahi nukeba dileh. uf hachi lehityatztzev al Adonai, deihu chayish name likara dishma da.

Hacha afligu ammudin kadmain dealma. chad amar, iyyov mechaside umot haolam hava. vechad amar, mechaside yisrael hava. vealke, lechappera al alma. deha yoma chad ashkecheh rav hamenuna leeliyyahu. amar leh, vadday tanenan deit tzaddik vera lo, rasha vetov lo. amar, tzaddik, kol shemmemuatin lo chovotav notnin lo baolam hazze chovo, veal ken tzaddik vera lo. vechol shemrubbin avonotav, umemuatin zachiotav, notnin lo secharo baolam hazze, rasha vetov lo. amar leh, dinoy demare alma atikin (sefer acher amikin) aval beshaata devae kudesha berich hu lechappera chovin dealma, alke bidroa dilhon, vease lechulehu. metal leasyay, dealke lidroa, leshezava lechol shayyfin. kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 53:5) vehu mecholal mippeshaenu vegomer. Kema deittemar, behahu yoma shel rosh hashshana, dekayymin shivin kattedrain lemedan dina lealma, kamma innun mare terisin, kategorin, dekayyme leella. illen mayyminin lizchu veillen masmeilin lechova, leadkera chovin dealma, chovin dechol chad vechad. veal da itzterich lebar nash, lefarsha chovoy, kol chad vechad kema deihu, begin deman dimfaresh chetoy, la itmesar dineh, ella bida demalka, kudesha berich hu bilchodoy. uman dedain leh kudesha berich hu, ihu letav. veal da baa david malka, (veamar) (Tehillim 43:1) shafteni elokim, ant, vela achara. vechen shelomo amar, (Melachim 1 8:59) laasot mishpat avdo, hu, vela achara, vechol bet din bedelin mimmennu.

Veal da itzterich lon lefarsha chovin dechol shayyfa veshayyfa, vechol ma deavid bifrat. hada hu dichtiv, (tehillim lev) chattati odiacha vegomer. levatar veatta nasata avon chattati sela. menalan. mimmoshe, dichtiv (Shemot 32) anna chata haam hazze vegomer. beyisrael ketiv, (Shmuel 1 12) chatanu ki azavnu et Adonai, dei tema hay beyachid, aval betzibbur la. ha ketiv kera da. vei tema ha betzibbur, aval shelicha dilhon la, ha ketiv (Shemot 32) vayyashav moshe el Adonai vegomer. uchetiv (Shemot 32) vayyaasu lahem vegomer. may tama. man dimfaresh choveh, be dina bedelin minneh, begin debar nash kariv legarmeh, vela itdan al pumeh.
Vetu, la shavik limkatrega leolfa aleh chova muma. devar nash yakdim
1484: Ihu din. dina adonay. dina demalchuta dina uteren gavvnin reshimin betalit, chad chivvavr, vechad techelet. veal teren gavvnin illen ittemar, (Shemot 24:10) vetachat raglav kemaase livnat hassappir. livnat, loven desappir. deihu kalil bitren gavvnin, rachame vedina, chivvavr veucham. uchamu ditchelet. veal teren gavvnin, remizu rabbanan, meematay korin et shema beshacharit, mishsheyyakkir ben techelet lelavan. lemehevi beratta demalka, keriat shema, yichuda dekudesha berich hu, kalil mitteren gavvnin illen, deinnun Adonai adonay, rachame vedina. kegavvna dekudesha berich hu kalil 2 gavvnin, Adonai adonay lemehevi rachame vedina, kisse din vechisse rachamim. (metatron)

(Yechezkel 1:26) kemare even sappir demut kisse. may demut kisse. ella lokovel kurseyay, deit leh amud bet gesharim. diyhe bar nash rashim bev kesharim, vechuleyayn detztzitztzit, lokovel amud bet gesharim dechurseyay. deinnun 18 kesharim, vechuleyayn lechol sitra. dechurseyay deihu Adonai, lechol sitra bed chevan dechurseyay, deinnun 4.

Veshit dargin dechurseyay, deinnun 6, veda metatron, ihu kalil 4 chevavn. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 11:6) venaar katon noheg bam. veinnun michael gavriel nuriel refael. metatron (Melachim 1 10:19) shesh maalot lachisse, desallekin shit mea, tzitztzit bitren yodin. vei chaser yod, ha chirik beatreh, hachi salleka. bechol sitra bed kanfe, tzitztzit utelat asar chulyayn detztzitztzit, innun 613.

Veod. shesh maalot lachisse, beraza da vav, salik lechushban 13, deitremiz bitlat tevin, vayyissa vayyavo vayyet. deinnun vahu ani vahu. chamesh kishrin, Adonai lechol sitra. 1 talit chad lechullehu. uveat Adonai ishtelim 18. deinnun 18. lemehevi chayya lechol sitra. kalil 4 chayot. ulechol chayya, arba anpin, vearba gadpin, innun 32 anpin vegadpin. veinnun talyayn mechayya deihu adam.

Veinnun 32, kechusheban yod hei hei. shelimu dilhon, vav. telesar chuleyayn bechol 4 kanfe, vehavav mityayched im kol arba chayot, veashlim leella, ashlim letatta. ammuda deemtztzaita ihu metatron, leashlema leella, kegavvna detiferet, shemeh keshem rabbeh. betztzalmo kidmuto itbere. deihu kalil kol dargin, meella letatta, umittatta leella. veihu achid beemtztzaita. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 26:28) vehabberiach hattichon betoch hakkerashim mavriach min hakkatztze el hakkatztze.

Veihu kalil 4 anpin, vearba gadpin dechol chayya vechayya dilella, deinnun, yeadadonahi. az yashir moshe. bechol chayya arba anpin, vearba gadpin, kegavvna da. 8 bearye. 8 beshor. 8 banesher. 8 baadam. deinnun 32 anpin vegadpin, bechusheban 8 4 zimnin.

Veinnun 4 anpin: Adonai. arba gadpin: adonay. lokovel 4 bigde zahav, vearba bigde lavan, delavish kahana lechappera al yisrael. lokovel, (Tehillim 51:17) adonay sefatay tiftach. utztzelota. ditfilla Adonai, bachatima 18 birchan ditztzelota. vetimne sare zimnin Adonai, it behon amud bet atvavn, bechusheban vaychullu, dichlilan betztzaddik chay almin.

Uvearba chivan, Adonai adonay. timne lechol sitra, innun 32 atvavn, 19 atvavn, deishtechachu min vahu ani vahu, ha telat asar, dichlilan ella vetatta. behon ishtelim adam, deihu 45, ammuda deemtztzaita.

Leella beilana dechayyi, let, kelifin. (Ester 4:2) ki en lavo el shaar hammelech bilvush sak. letatta it kelifin bimtatron, deihu bediyyukena deammuda deemtztzaita. divzimna dekudesha berich hu levar mimalchuteh, itkasse begadpin veanpin deeved dileh, hada hu dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 22:11) vayyirkav al keruv vayyaof.

Veinnun kelippin desacharin led chevan dimtatron, innun: tohu, (Melachim 1 19:11) vehinne ruach gedola vechazak mefarek harim umeshabber selaim lo varuach Adonai. bohu, veachar haruach raash lo varaash Adonai, ha teren kelifin, yarok vechivvavr, diklifin deegoza, chad tohu, kav yarok, tinyayna bohu, avanin mefullamin, kelifa takkifa, keavna mefullama. lokovel teren kelifin illen, motz veteven dechita.

Kelifa telitaa, dekika. lokovel subbin dechita, dehacha ihu mitdebak bachita, vela yachil leitparsha mittamman, ad detachanin leh berechayyay, deinnun lokovel tochanot defuma debar nash, detztzarich lemitchan behon millin deorayyta, ad dihon kekemach solet nekiyya, uvenafa deihi safa, itberir pesolet deihi subbin (deorayyta) ad deyishtechach halacha solet nekiyya. behahu zimna, natil lah libba umocha, vechol evarin degufa deitpeshshat behon nishmeta, veitparnnesat bah nishmeta, kegavvna degufa itparnnesat bemillin dealma, (Kohelet 7:14) deze leumat ze asa elohim, nahama degufa, venahama deorayyta. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 9:Adonai) lechu lachamu belachmi.
Vehay kelifa, ihu kiklifa demitdabbeka bemocha deegoza, uvezimna deegoza ihi rechicha, itperash hahi kelifa mimmocha deegoza, bela kusheya. uvezimna deegoza ihi
1485: Yevesha, kashe lebar nash leabera leh mittamman, ki adayin hakkusheya bimkomah omedet. uvegin da mane kudesha berich hu lebar nash, leahadra betiyyuveta bevachruteh, kodem deyazkin beh yetztzer hara. hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 19:32) mippene seva takum, kodem seva dilach. vehay kelippa ihi esh, veittemar bah veachar haraash esh lo baesh Adonai. reviaa, tehom. chalal deegoza, beh kol demama dakka, tamman ka ate malka, (Yechezkel 1:4) umittochah keen hachashmal mittoch haesh.

Veinnun kelifin, innun reshimin bed evarim degufa. berea, tamman lecha, deminah ishtechachu sirchot derea, (Mishlei Adonai:Adonai-6) ragleha yordot mavt sheol tzeadeha yitmochu. vetamman ruach chazak mefarek, dedafik bechanfe rea debar nash, vehay ihu rucha deasir gufeh debar nash, ma dechafif leh eliyyahu techotoy, vesalik leella beh. hada hu dichtiv, (Melachim 2 2:11) vayyaal eliyyahu bassoara hashshamayma. vehay dafik al rea, deshota kol mashkin. uvehon, (Bereshit 1:2) veruach elohim merachefet al pene hammayim, hay ihu kelifa lerucha dekudesha. lismala, ruach seara, alayyhu ittemar, (Kohelet 10:2) lev chacham limino velev kesil lismolo.

David abar leh millibboy, vekatil leh. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 109:22) velibbi chalal bekirbi uvegin da zacha, linshava ruach tzefonit, bechinnor dileh. veittemar beh, (Yechezkel 37:9) ko amar Adonai mearba ruchot boi haruach, vahava menaggen beh bakkinnor, bed mine niggunin, beshir pashut, deihu 10. uveshir kaful, deihu 14. uveshir meshullash, deihu 20. uveshir merubba, deihu Adonai. ha innun eser atvavn. deavad david lokovlayyhu, 10 mine tilim. vesallekin lev anpin, kechusheban 10 atvavn illen.

Umatay seliku bev mine nigguna. kad itavar shuletanuta deavon mashchit af vechema. dibbehon dafik ruach seara. bearba sitrin, desallekin ley kitrin lev umin, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 11:10) uvaavod reshaim rinna.

Demichael gavriel nuriel refael, shaltin al 4 sitrin (sefer acher yesodin) tavin debar nash, deinnun mayya veeshsha verucha veafra, vechol chad it leh 4 anpin. avon mashchit af vechema, talyayn (sefer acher shaltin) al mara levana, derea deavid sircha. uvemara sumaka dechaved, deitaddam bemaadim. uvemara yeroka daachida bechavda, deihu charba demalach hammavt, deittemar bah (Mishlei Adonai:4) veacharitah mara challaana chadda kecherev piyyot. uvemara shechora, lilit, shabbetay, shuletanuta batchol, deihu atztzivu, sheol tachtit, aniyyuta vachashocha bichya vehespeda veraavon.

Miyyad demitavrin illen kelifin mibbar nash, shalta aleh ilana dechayyi, bev anpin, deinnun 10 yad yedu Adonai, deishtechachu asara talyayn mearba ruchot, deinnun yedod, deittemar behon, ko amar yedod mearba ruchot boi haruach, da hu rucho demashiach. deittemar beh, (Yeshayahu 11:2) venacha alav ruach Adonai, kad ihu menashshev beozen yemina delibba, detamman chachma missitra dechesed, deveh harotztze lehachekim yadrim bechachma. vechesed nashav babbina, devachachma 10. babbina Adonai. betiferet 6. bammalchut Adonai. yedod dafik bechullehu arba. desallekin leeser. 108 machashava delibba.
Da yod hei vav hei, yemina ihu mayim. veihu yad haggedola. missemala esh. veihi yad hachazaka. beammuda deemtztzaita, yad rama. deihi rucha dekudsha. vecholla ben 14.

(Yechezkel 1:12) ki ruach hachayya baofannim el asher yihye shamma haruach lalechet yelechu. beh mitnahagim mayya veeshsha. deachid betarvayyhu, vedafik bearkin democha, deihu mayim. uvearkin delibba, deihu esh. veruach bechanfe rea.
Bechol ever veever degufa, ishtechach galgalle yamma deorayyta, vegalgalle rekia, deinnun eshsha. kullehu sallekin venachtin beh. veihu atreh ben rekia veyamma, mana dileh ara, deihi shechinta.

Uchegavvna deofin, petichu gadfayyhu, lekabbela rucha lefarcha beh. hachi kol evarim degufa, petichan bechamma mekorin, bechamma pirkin, bechamma arkin, bechamma iddarin delibba, iddarin democha, lekabbela leh. dei lav denashiv bevattin delibba, hava nura delibba, okid kol gufa. vechamma sulamin, veiddarin, dearkin dekane delibba, vekane derea, kullehu mittatkkenin legabbeh.

Kad salik dibbura, al kanfe derea, itavid kol. behahu zimna (Kohelet 10:20) ki of hashshamayim yolich et hakkol. (Tehillim 29:3) kol Adonai al hammayim. missitra demayya, deihu mocha, detamman salik bechanfe rea. kol Adonai chotztzev lahavot esh, missitra delibba, kad nafik mippuma, itkere dibbur.
Velokovel teren kanfe rea, defatchin gadpin lekabbela leh, hada hu dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:11) ufenehem vechanfehem perudot milmala. hachi sifvavn natlin leh ledibbur, ufarchin leh leella.

Uchegavvna deinnun chamisha kanfe (sefer acher anfe) rea, kullehu petichan bela sircha, lekabbela hay kol, hachi name tzerichin lemehevi chamsha tikkunin defuma, kullehu petichan bela sircha, bechamesh tikkunin deinnun:
1486: Achehaa bagaron. bavemaf besifvavn. gaykak bachech. dotolonott belishana. zasesharetz bashshinayim.

Vedibbur diyhe behon, bela sircha veikkuva kelal. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 24:15) vayhi hu terem killa ledabber vehinne rivka yotztzet. da tzelota, deihu dibbur. uvegineh ittemar, im shegura tefillati befi yodea ani shemkubbal. vei it sircha venafka beikkuva, yodea ani shemturaf. begin (sefer acher kegon) sircha berea deihi terefa.

Vekol da shema yisrael, deveh (Yechezkel 1:24) vaeshma et kol kanfehem. veda Adonai deihu kol, kad nafik lekabbela shechinta bitztzelota bachashay, deihu dibbur, deveh adonay sefatay tiftach, kol evarin petichan kullehu gadfayyhu, bermch tevin, deinnun bed parshiyayn dikriat shema, divhon nachit kala.

Vechad nachit, kamma tzipporin metztzaftztzefin legabbeh, bechamma mine niggun, kullehu al evarin degufa, deinnun anpe ilana. uvechol gadpin dechol ever, detamman diyyura detztzippora, deihi adonay, bechol anfa veanfa, ishtechach peticha legabbe devalah. adonay sefatay tiftach, ihu pitcha legabbeh, bitztzelota daamida. let ever 288 evarim dishchinta, delav ihi peticha lekabbela leh. uvegin da itkeriat sichat malache hashsharet. ihu tziftztzuf ofot, deinnun nishmatin desharyayn baevarim. ihi sichat dekallim, deinnun anfin deilana.

Uvehahu zimna, denachit Adonai legabbe adonay bechol ever, ittemar behu, (Yechezkel 1:24) beamdam terappena kanfehem. vehay raza dechashmal. chayot esh, ittim chashot, veittim memallelot. veamru mare matnitin, bematnita tana, keshehaddibbur yotztze mippi hakkadosh baruch hu, chashot, uchesheen haddibbur yotztze mippi hakkadosh baruch hu, memallelot. behahu zimna demityaychadin kol vedibbur kachada, deinnun yeahdonahy, chashot. aval bezimna difnehem vechanfehem perudot, Adonai min adonay beferuda, ihu ishtechach bearba anpe chevan, kullehu petichan, lokovleh memallelot, lemishal mezona, begin (Daniel 4) demazon lecholla beh. adonay ishtechach bechanfe hachayyot, kullehu petichan legabbe chevan.

Shaagin bekol deihu Adonai, kullehu bimina. ofannim metztzaftztzefan bedibbur, deihu adonay bismala. bisrafim mitchabberim kol vedibbur beemtztzaita. yeahdonahy. behon (Bereshit 1:20) veof yeofef. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 6:6) vayyaaf elay echad min hasserafim. veittemar behon, (Kohelet 10:20) veof hashshamayim yolich et hakkol uvaal kenafayim yaggid davar. userafim shesh kenafayim leechad. missitra deat 6, deihu ammuda deemtztzaita, kalil yemina usemala. veihu kalil shit tevin, (Yeshayahu 6:2) bishtayim yechasse panav uvishtayim yechasse raglav uvishtayim yeofef siman.
Tikkuna tinyayna, (Yechezkel 1:26) veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam alav milmala. reshimu desefer tora, veihu (Yeshayahu 44:13) ketiferet adam lashevet bayit.

Veokmuha rabbanan, kol hakkore keriat shema arvit veshacharit, keillu mekayyem (Yehoshua 1:8) vehagita bo yomam valayla. detallit levana, ihu limina missitra dechesed. veittemar, el melech yoshev al kisse rachamim umitnaheg bachasidut. (Yeshayahu 16:5) vehuchan bachesed kisse. chesed salik amud bet chuleyayn vekishrin detallit.

Veit talit missitra dimtatron, deihu tet, kalil 18, ben kishrin vechuleyayn lechol sitra. Adonai kishrin lokovel Adonai chomashe tora. utelesar chuleyayn, lokovel telesar mechilan derachame deorayyta. deittemar behon, 15 middot hattora nidreshet.

Uveginah ittemar, kemare adam alav milmala. bediyyukena detiferet, deihu tiferet adam alav milmala. veitkere bishmeh, yod hei vav hei. (Yeshayahu 43:7) kol hanikra vishmi velichvodi berativ yetztzartiv af asitiv. uleella kemare adam, da shechinta, deihi kechezu deammuda deemtztzaita, bed anpin, uveeser sefiran, deinnun adam. vearba anpin deadam, arba atvavn. veinnun 14 atvavn, uvehon (Hoshea 12:11) uveyad hanneviim adamme.

Veod itkere chay, missitra detztzaddik, uveh kudesha berich hu ushechinteh itkere az adam, deihu ammuda deemtztzaita, tal, ushechinteh Adonai. uve ihu adam. begin detal hachi salik bechusheban yod hei vav. vehay ihu morid hatal, legabbe hei. kesher detalit, chay almin, dekashir kudesha berich hu ushechinteh bechol sitrin, bearba kanfot detalit.

Tefillin missemala, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 62:8) nishba Adonai bimino uvizroa uzzo. bimino, zo tora. uvizroa uzzo, ellu tefillin. Adonai bed parshiyayn. adonay hechala led atvavn, bed batte ditfilin. kesher shel tefilin deyad, da tzaddik chay almin, deihu kishshura detarvavyyhu. bizroa semala. kesher deresha, da ammuda deemtztzaita, deachid beh Adonai ehye leella, deinnun (620) chachma uvina.

Keriat shema deihu yichuda beemtztzaita, veihu achid ben tzitztzit utefilin, dechullehu parshiyayn detztzitztzit utefilin, innun kelilan beyichuda dikriat shema. umissitra deammuda deemtztzaita, deihu talit utefilin, deittemar behu, (Shemot 13:16) vehaya leot al yadcha uletotafot ben enecha. (Bamidbar 15:38) veasu lahem tzitztzit.
1487: 300 Shel tefilin, halacha lemoshe missinay. (Devarim 28:10) verau kol amme haaretz ki shem Adonai nikra alecha vayyiru mimmeka. veokmuha may shem Adonai. ellu tefillin shebbaroosh. 300 shel tefillin. teren shinin shit mea. shit dargin. vesheva anfin ditren shinin, ha telat asar, vecholla 613. velet pikkuda delav ihi shekila lechol orayyta.

Kegavvna da, kol mitztzeva ihi Adonai. yah im shemi 365. 11 im zichri 248. uvegin da kol mitztzeva ihi shekila letryg. veha ukemuha, shema yisrael kalil 613, missitra detztzitztzit. vetryg missitra ditfillin ihu bechol atar.

Vehayu letotafot, totafot: tat, 18 almin, tzaddik, lekavleh metatron. pat, tiferet. metatron sus detiferet, deveh kol sefiran mitlabbeshin. vehachi ihu kegufa lenishmeta. vechad kudesha berich hu istallak minneh, ishtear illem, let leh kol vela dibbur. ishtechach, dekudesha berich hu ushechinteh ihu kol vedibbur. dechol malach umalach. uvechol kala vedibbur deorayyta, uvechol kala ditztzelota. uvechol pikkuda ufikkuda. bechol atar shuletanuteh beillain vetattain, ihu chayyim decholla, ihu savil kolla.

Velet adonay bela yedod, kegavvna delet dibbur bela kol. velet kol bela dibbur. vehay ihu keshot, bealma daatztzilut. aval bealma deferuda, it kol bela dibbur. kesher shel tefillin shadday, achid beh ella vetatta. veda tzaddik chay almin, achid (sefer acher beh) ben kol vedibbur.

Addehachi, ha raya mehemana izdeman legabbe sava, veamar sava sava, tefillin vetztzitztzit ufarashat mezuza, innun 3 pikkudin, kelilan bekriat shema. vekriat shema pikkuda reviaa. vetztzitztzit adkar 3 zimnin. uvattefillin adkar behu teren zimnin ot. uvatztzitztzit 7 shel tizkeru detztzarich lehattiz bah. uvemmezuza, shadday milvar, Adonai millego.

Ufarshiyayn setimin ufetichan amay. veshiur arkah detztzitztzit verochbah, detakinu orech kol hatztzitztzit teren asar etztzeban begudal. mitztzevat techelet, shelish gedil, ushene shelishe anaf. uven kesher lekesher kimlo gudal. vechol chuleya vechuleya tihye meshuleshet. vehachi tefillin amay bemocha. velokovel libba. veshiur retztzuathon amay innun ad libba lismala. vead tabbura limina. uretztzua deyad ad deyichroch vishallesh telat zimnin beetztzeba tzerada.

Ella, vadday beged chashuv lav ihu, ella shalosh al shalosh lechol sitra. innun teresar, lokovel 4 bigde lavan, ved bigde zahav, ved bigde dechohen hedyot. umissitra devirkat kohen hedyot ka ramiz, al tehi birkat hedyot kala beenecha. shelish gedil, ushene shelishi anaf, deihu techelet.

Vechol chuleya meshuleshet, kol meshulash missitra dikdushsha. hada hu dichtiv kedushsha lecha yeshalleshu. veyisrael shelishiyya, begin (Shemot 14) divshalishim al kullo. detztzitztzit missitra deammuda deemtztzaita, deihu telitaa laavahan, vechol davar meshulash, 17 50, kol teva meshuleshet missitroy. chuleya kelila mittelat kerichot meshullashin, da shechinta. kedushsha lecha yeshalleshu. veihi meshuleshet beammuda deemtztzaita, kalil telat anpe avahan, deinnun 300 min shabbat, shechinta bat yechida. (sefer acher malya min) chulya, techelet shebbatztzitztzit.

Zakkaa gufa, dehachi ihu rashim, bishchinta vekudesha berich hu, al kanfe demitztzeva. rashim birtztzua deihu tefilla deyad, bitlat kerichot beetztzeba tzerada. deihi kegavvna dechuleya, kericha bitlat kerichot beetztzeba. rashim bekesher ditfillin, kalil bitren kishrin, sallekin chamisha asar meshulashin, teren bekishra chad.
Shelosha asar chuleyayn, it behon tisha usheloshim kerichan, kechusheban tal. ushelosha asar chulyayn, kechusheban echad. sallekin ben. vehay ihu ben yah. ammuda deemtztzaita.

Kol kesher bediyyukena dechaf yemina, kol chuleya bediyyukena deetztzeba, deit beh telat pirkin, lokovel telat kerichot. vehachi bechol etztzeba telat pirkin, levar miggudal. deihu shiur ben kesher lekesher detztzitztzit, kimlo gudal. ihi midda dechotama. umidda deayin yemina usemala. veihu midda ben ayin leayin. umidda deozn yemina usemala. umidda dechol safa vesafa. umidda delishana. (Shemot 26:2) midda achat lechol hayeriot.

Amma shiur degufa, learba sitrin veella vetatta. deinnun shit ammot. uvechol amma veamma shelosha pirkin, 18 pirkin beshit ammin. veinnun raza 22 ninuin delulav. leshit sitrin. telat ninuin lechol sitra. vealayyhu ittemar, (Shir HaShirim 7:8) zot komatech damta letamar. veda shiur koma, mikve yisrael bishchinta, ihu 18 arba zimnin, deinnun arba sallekin shivim ushenayim.
1488: (Yechezkel 1:18) vegabbehem vegova lahem veyira lahem vegabbotam vegomer, vegabbehem, arba chevan demerkavta tattaa. vegova lahem, 4 chevan demerkavta metztziata. vegabbotam, arba chevan demerkavta telitaa. vechullehu 12. veinnun meleot enayim, kegavvna da saviv learbatan, yedod yedod yedod.

Umare dekoma reshimin behon bitztzelota, bean atar. ella kol hakkorea korea bevaruch. vechol hazzokef zokef bashem. zekifot arbaa. ucheriot 4. ha hacha ka ramiz beillen zekifot ucheriot, molich umevi lemi shed ruchot haolam shello, maale umorid lemi shehashshamayim vehaaretz shello. veinnun shit sitrin, shamayim vaaretz ved ruchot. lokovel telat birchan kadmain, utelat batrain, beose shalom bimromav 4, keria uzekifa lismala, ucheria uzekifa limina. vehay ihu noten shalom lismolo vimino, lismol rabbo, velimin rabbo.

Ha innun teresar, ben (kerichot) (keriot) ukkeriot uzekifot. uvehon amud bet ayynin. 6 keriot behon 18 ninuin, 3 bechol paam, rosh veguf vezanav, detztzarich lemichra. bechy chuleyayn sallekin amud bet. beillen amud bet ayynin dekudesha berich hu, naharin amud bet gadpin dishchinta, vekamat alayyhu, veitkeriat amida. divkadmeta nefila ihi, vetztzarich leakkama lah beshem yedod, bechay almin, uvearba zekifot beshit birchan, deihu tiferet, kalil telat birchan kadmain, utelat birchan batrain.

Ulemichra bechay almin, vehay ihu 12 6. kol hakkorea korea bevaruch, vechol hazzokef zokef beshem Adonai. ammuda deemtztzaita vetztzaddik 12 6. illaa bina ben 15 veinnun remizin bevayyisa vayyavo vayyit 6 illaa. ben 15 achid bizkifa ucheria, vechullehu sallekin 18 birchan ditztzelota.

4 Keriot baadonay, 4 zekifot baydod, ammuda deemtztzaita. ushechinta chay almin, kashir lon, veda yeahadonahy, amen, bechol birchata 58 birchan, 18 zimnin yedod innun amud bet ayynin, denaharin bev gadpin, deinnun 18 zimnin adonay.

Veraza demilla, vegabbehen, vegova lahem, vegabbotam. vegabbehen: gadpin. vegova lahem: anpin. vegabbotam: deinnun alayyhu. meleot enayim saviv learbatan, kullehu merubbaot. vecholla keshot, 70 anpin (nusach acher anpin) leorayyta. gadpin, adonay. anpin, Adonai. ayynin, ehye. vesallekin yabbok bechusheban, adonay, bemaase. yedod, bedibbur. ehye, bemachashava.

Bechol ayin veayin, shiur gudal. veda 6 benoni. vev pirkin begudal, innun 10 10. lokovel chotama 6. lokovel 2 nukve chotama, 10 10. vesallekin yod he. veda vayyitztzer. shiur dechol midda umidda, yod he, bechol atar shaltanuteh, bechol ever veever. kol ever, kegon (Devarim 32:11) yifros kenafav yikkachehu yissaehu al evrato.

Let ever bechol merkavto, delav ihu kol ever bediukeneh. uvechol atar ishtechach, (Yechezkel 1:11) ufenehem vechanfehem perudot milmala. lokovel parshiyayn petichan ditfillin. lokovel tora. vechad letatta, innun setimin parshiyayn, lokovel yeahdonahy alayyhu. beanpoy vegadpoy.

Vekudesha berich hu rashim beyisrael lekabbelayyhu, bitztzelota lemehevi chaverim bahadayyhu, lemichra bechol gufayyhu, betimne sere birchan ditztzelota, leamlecha alayyhu amen, veihu yeahdonahy, bechol ever veever dilhon, veamar kudesha berich hu, man dela havi rashim kodamayychu, lemehevi korea bevaruch, vezokef baAdonai, bekoma degufa, la yeul tzeloteh behechala dili, deihu adonay. la tekabbelun millin dileh, al gadpayychu veanpayychu, dechol man dimtztzalle baadonay, umetztzaref laydod anpin (sefer acher anafin) demalachin, ufenehem vechanfehem perudot leella, (sefer acher lenatla) yeahadonahy, bemillin ditztzelota denafkin mippumoy devar nash.

Vegadol haone amen yoter min hammevarech. dilgabbe adonay Adonai bitztzelota, ufenehem vechanfehem perudot. lokovel Adonai beanpin, adonay begadpin, (Shemot 25:19) keruv echad mikkatztza mizze ucheruv echad mikkatztza mizze. aval kad chazar sheliach tzibbur tzelota, veone amen, ihu bammachberet hashshenit, mitchabberin teren shemahan bammachberet hashshenit. bekadmita, (Shemot 26:4) makbilot hallulaot achat el echat bakrashim, deinnun kesher etztzeban. aval beamen, (Shemot 26:5) vehaya hammishkan echad, deveh chovrot ishsha el achotah.

Tikkuna telitaa seder dibbura (sefer acher cheder dedibbura) ditztzelota, deveh chevan eshsha memallelan. vehay hi (Yechezkel 1:27) vaere keen chashmal kemare esh bet lah saviv. hay ihu raza dechashmal. deinnun chevan eshsha, ittim chashot ittim memallelot. veinnun dechashot lesefer tora, bezimna dedibbur nafik mippi hakkore, ihu chashiv legabbayyhu, keillu mekabbelim orayyta betura desinay. uvezimna deamar ihu anochi, la ishtema kala, vela dibbura achara dechevan, ella dileh.
Kegavvna da, kad dibbura da nafik mippumeh dekudesha berich hu, chayot esh chashot. uvezimna deshatik chayot esh memallelot. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 20:15) vechol haam roim
1489: Et hakkolot, kalin dechevan, dahavo shaagin. veet hallappidim, dahavo nafkin bedibbur dechevan, bechamma mine niggun kodam malka. veillen deinnun dechashot lesefer tora, innun bediukenayyhu dechevan. umane lon kudesha berich hu, leaala lon, becheder demare esh bet lah.

Veod innun dechashot (sefer acher veod inun denafik minnayyhu dibbura bitzlota deveh chevan eshsha memallan veinnun dacheshavet) bitztzelota 20 birchan, yialun becheder demara da. veod innun dechashot lahalacha, deittemar bah, agra dishmateta sevara, yealun becheder deihu hechol demara da, deorayyta, ala ittemar (Yirmeyahu 23:29) halo cho devari kaesh neum Adonai uchefatish yefotztzetz sala. veda sela deittemar beh (Bamidbar 20:8) vedibbartem el hassela leenehem venatan memav. illen demishtaddelin bah lishmah, nafik lon mayya deorayyta metikan, veittemar behon, (Bamidbar 20:11) vattesht haeda uveiram. veillen dela mishtaddelin bah lishmah, nafik lon mayim meririn, deittemar behon (Shemot 1:14) vaymararu et chayyehem baavoda kasha: da kusheya. bechomer: da kal vachomer. uvilvenim: belibbun halacha.

Tikkuna reviaa vachamishshaa, (Yechezkel 1:27) mimmare matnav ulemala umimmare matnav ulemata. divhon shoke hachayyot keneged kulan, uvisfiran netztzach vehod. metatron ot betztzava dileh, veihu diyyukena detztzaddik. detztzaddik ot betztzava dilella, umetatron ihu ot betztzava diltatta. metatron shadday beh, (Yechezkel 1:14) vehachayyot ratztzo vashov kemare habbazak.

Veraglehem regel yeshara, deraglin demazzikin kullehu akallaton. veraglehen, veraglin dechevan, kaddishin, ittemar behon veraglehem regel yeshara, mitztzad chayya deihu yisrael, yisrael kalil telat chevan, deittemar behon haavot hen hen hammerkava.

(Yechezkel 1:7) vechaf raglehem kechaf regel egel, missitra dechayya deihu shor. venotztzetztzim keen nechoshet kalal, missitra denachash bariach deyamma. deihu salik legabbeh beyabbeshta. ratztzo, missitra denuriel, desalik ratztzo. vashov, missitra deshadday. dehachi salik bechusheban. veihu salik metatron.

Vechad havo yisrael shamin kala mimmizrach, havo ratztzin tamman. velmmaarav hachi, vechen laddarom velatztzafon. amar kudesha berich hu lemalache hashsharet, illen derahatin litztzelota demitztzeva, verahatin lefirka beshabbeta, verahatin lemebad reuta dili, vetayyvin betiyyuveta. kabbilu lon behechala dehay mara, divillen simanin, innun chaverim bahadayychu, innun deratztzin veshavin beorayyta, bedibbura dahalacha, innun reshimin bahadayychu, veailu lon behay hechala.

Hachi kad metztzalin yisrael, michael tas alma betisa chada. vegavriel tas bitren tasin. vechad nafik dibbura miyisrael, bahalacha, bitztzelota, uvechol pikkuda dishchinta tamman. innun ratztzin legabbah, veshavin bah bishlichut marehon. uvechol atar deshamin kala deorayyta, detamman kudesha berich hu, innun ratztzin legabbe hahu kala, vetayyvin bah bishlichuta demarehon. divchol kala deshem Adonai let tamman, bedibbura delet tamman adonay, la ratztzin veshavin tamman. uvegin da, veraglehem regel yeshara, (Hoshea 14:10) ki yesharim darche Adonai, baatar daydod tamman, ihu derech yeshara. vei let tamman Adonai, lav ihu derech yeshara.

Veod raglehem regel yeshara, amru mare matnitin, deman dimtztzale, bae letakkena ragloy bitztzeloteh, kemalache hashsharet. kechaf regel egel, lemehevi rashim bahadayyhu. uvegin da, okmuha rabbanan, hamitpalel tzarich lechavvivn et raglav, shenneemar vechaf raglehem kechaf regel egel. veamar kudesha berich hu, illen deinnun reshimin bitztzelotayyhu hachi, lechavvivn ragloy kevavtayychu, aftechu lon tare hechala, leaala bemara da.

Tikkuna shetitaa, (Yechezkel 1:27) raiti kemare esh, hacha reiyyay mammash. amar kudesha berich hu, man deyeul bechezu da, vihe bitztzeloteh libbeh leella, leshem Adonai, veenoy letatta bishma daadonay, tealun behechala da, kegavvna demalachin, vegabbehen leella, veyira lahem letatta, lokovel shechinta deihi yirat Adonai.

Uviriyyay ushemia verecha vedibbur, sharya Adonai. baasiyyay, bemishush, shimmush, hiluch, sharya adonay. veda reiyya, deor vener (sefer acher deorayyta), deittemar bah (Mishlei 6:23) vetora or. recha dekarbenin, deinnun tzelotin, dibbur beorayyta, dibbur bitztzelota. vaasiyyay demitztzeva, veshimush dilah, umishush dilah, vehiluch dilah. ureiyay ushemia, delet tamman orayyta umitztzeva, kudesha berich hu ushechinteh la sharya tamman. dekudesha berich hu sharya biriyay, vechen shechinteh, deorayyta vetora or, shechinteh reiya dileh yedod (Bamidbar 12:6) bemara elav etvda, (kudesha berich hu bemare elav etvadda shechinteh).

Bemachashava millego bina, ben yah. yisrael ala bemachashava. hirhur chachma, lechakkima birmiza. chachma ala bemachashava deihu bina, machashava vehirhur kolla chad. chachma la ishtemoda ella bebina, uvina ballev. uvegin da, machashava ballev, hirhur ballev.
1490: Lishmoa. vechen bechotama, reach nichoach laAdonai. shechinta ihi karban dileh, ola dileh, utztzelota ihi kekarban, uchereach nichoach selikat legabbeh, veitkerivat legabbeh bitztzelota, vehachi bedibbur, (Yirmeyahu 23:29) halo cho devari kaesh neum Adonai. Adonai shechinta, dibbur dileh.

Kegavvna dishchinta, ihi mara dileh, shemia dileh, reach nichoach dileh, dibbur dileh, beresha. hachi ihu beyadin, asiyyayt mitztzeva dileh, begufa keria dileh. bitztzelota zekifa dileh, bitztzelota amida dileh, (deihi mazaleh) deihu dekayyeyma kammeh bechol atar, ucheraat legabbeh, veitnappelat leragloy binfilat appayim, lemishal minneh rachamim al benaha, ihi anava legabbeh, veit lah boshet panim minneh.

Vela keshifcha bisha, lilit, chatztzufa bela anava, let lah boshet panim, imma deerev rav, uvegin da amar shelomo, (Mishlei 12:4) eshet chayil ateret balah ucherakav beatztzemotav mevisha. dishchinta ihi matronita, shifcha dilah lilit, let lah anava, vela boshet anpin mikudesha berich hu. vehachi benaha erev rav, vekudesha berich hu atid leabera lah velivnaha mealma, demamzerim innun mibbene 9 middot, 511 751, (600 122, 362, nidduy, temura, moredet, sechura, gerushat hallev, chatzufa, taarovet) mamzere derabbanan.

Vechen shechina ihi shimmush dekudesha berich hu, yichud dileh betztzaddik chay almin. veihi halicha dileh, (Tehillim 85:14) tzedek lefanav yehallech, lemebad reuteh. (Bereshit 24:15) vayhi hu terem killa ledabber vehinne rivka yotztzet, rehitat legabbeh, lemebad reuteh. biriyya, bishmia, berecha, bedibbur, baasiyya, begufa, beshimush, behiluch, bechol ever, ihi metztzuvva leshammesha leh, ulemebad reuteh.

Uvenaha, hachi innun bediukenaha, bene anava, bene boshet anpin, kullehu kemiddot dilah. uvegin da mane kudesha berich hu lemoshe, (Shemot 18:21) veatta techez mikkol haam anshe chayil yire elohim anshe emet sone vatztza. anshe chayil, missitra dimina deavraham, detamman reiyyay deorayyta, (Devarim 33) mimino esh dat lamo. yire elohim, missitra deyitztzechak, detamman shemia, deamar chavakkuk nevia (Chavakuk 3:2) Adonai shamati shimacha yareti. anshe emet, missitra deyaakov, detamman reach nichoach laydod, bechotama. sone vatztza, missitra dedibbur, samcha reviaa, deadam harishon, deitchabbar baavahan. telat chevan innun, arye shor nesher, biriyay shemia recha, adam bedibbur.
Vesamta alehem sare alafim, missitra deat 1. vesare meot, missitra deat 4, 4 meot shana deishtabidu yisrael bemitztzerayim. (bedallut deorayyta) sare chamishshim 50. vesare asarot 10.

Yisrael beinnun middot ishtemodun, deinnun benoy dekudesha berich hu ushechinteh. lemehevi behon anshe chayil, kegon eshet chayil ateret balah, mare dechesed. yire elohim. anshe emet, vela anshe sheker, divne (Tzefanya 3:13) yisrael lo yaasu avla velo yedabberu chazav velo yimmatztze befihem leshon tarmit. vesone vatztza, kebar nash sameach bechelko. vela keerev rav benoy deshifcha bisha, deinnun kechivya dechol ara kodameh. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 65:25) venachash afar lachmo, vedachil lemisba meafra, dedachil detechsar leh. vehachi mare batztza. dela sevein mikkol mamon dealma.

Uvegin da okmuha mare matnitin, lo hammidrash hu haikkar ella hammaase. begin dekudesha berich hu ihu satim besitre hattora, bemay ishtemoda. bammitztzevot, deihi shechinteh, deihi diyyukeneh. kegavvna deihu anav, shechinteh anava. ihu chasid, veihi chasida. ihu gibbor, veihi geveret al kol umin dealma. ihu emet, veihi emuna. ihu navi, veihi nevia. ihu tzaddik veihi tzadeket. ihu melech, veihi malchut. ihu chacham, veihi chachmeta. ihu mevin, veihi tevuna dileh. ihu keter, veihi atara dileh, ateret tiferet. uvegin da ukemuha rabbanan, kol mi sheen tocho kevaro al yikkanes levet hammidrash. kediyyukena dekudesha berich hu, deihu tocho ushechinta baro, ihu tocho millego, veihi baro millevar. vela ishteniat ihi dilvar, mehahu dilgo, leishtemoda dehi atztziluteh, velet afrashuta tamman kelal, (Shemot 25:11) demibbayit umichutz tetztzappennu.

Uvegin deihu yedod, satim millegav, la itkere ella bishchinte, adonay. uvegin da amru rabbanan, lo kesheani nichtav ani nikra, baolam hazze, nichtav ani baydod, venikra ani baadonay. aval baolam habba, nichtav baydod, venikra baydod. lemehevi rachame mikkol sitra uvegin da mane kudesha berich hu lemalache hashsharet, man dela yehe tocho kevaro, bechol evarin penimain vechitztzonin, la yiul behechala da. uvegin da amar kera, (Devarim 32:4) hatztzur tamim poolo. (Devarim 18:13) tamim tihye im Adonai elohecha.

Tikkuna sheviaa, (Yechezkel 1:28) kemare hakkeshet asher yihye beanan beyom haggeshem. amru rabbanan, min (Yechezkel 1:28) vaere ad kemare hakkeshet hen hen maase hammerkava. veamru chachamim, keshehaya ribbi akiva doresh bemaase merkava, yarda esh min hashshamayim, vesibbeva hailanot. vehayu mitkabbetztzin malache hashsharet kivmizmute
1491: Chatan vechalla. begin delet yichuda vekishshura umerkava, leshem Adonai baadonay, ella betztzaddik. deihu keshet, deihi (davar acher deveh) merkavta shelemata dilella, yeahadonahy.

Shechinta ihi maase bereshit, veokmuha, en dorshin bemaase bereshit bishnayim. begin deanpin deilana, innun perudot millemala bechanfe chevan, Adonai limina, adonay lismala. chatan limina, kalla lismala. kad atyayn lah lachuppa, bechamma mine nigguna, tzerichin yisrael leatteara lon letatta, beshirot vetushbachot, bechol mine nigguna bitztzelota, ha ka atyayn lachuppa.

Utztzerichin yisrael lemehav kidushin lakkalla. mechatana, bekishshura ditfilla deyad, lemehevi keshira leh, uleatra lon bitfilin deresha, deihu peer, hada hu dichtiv, (Yechezkel 24:17) peercha chavush alecha. utelat kerichin dirtztzua, lokovel 3 kedushshot, deinnun kadosh kadosh kadosh, (retzua) kedushsha lecha yeshalleshu. vetztzarich levarcha lon besheva birchan, deinnun sheva berachot dikriat shema, bashshachar shetayim lefaneha veachat leachareha. uvaerev shetayim lefaneha ushetayim leachareha.

Vechalla bechuppa, deihi bediyyukena dechanfe mitztzeva, betztzitztziot muzehavot, utechelet velavan, kisse den vechisse rachamim, kalil da beda. vechamma kesharim vechulyayn, sacharaneh. bechamma margelan vaavanin yakkirin, malyayn segulot, sacharin legabbeh, kediukena dezagin verimmonin, dilvushe malka umatronita, deinnun 4 bigde lavan, ved bigde zahav, missitra ditren shemahan, Adonai adonay, kishmo ken kiso, ken chufato, ken levusho. rashim shemeh becholla, kad bae leaala behechaleh, lemehevi tamman chatan bechallateh, bechy birchan ditztzelota, deihi (nusach acher behechala leyachada tamman bitzlota 20 birchan detzaddik deihu) kemare hakkeshet.

En dorshin bammerkava beyachid, begin dehaddoresh leyyachid, immeh ha innun shenayim badderasha. vela tzarich tamman lemishma kala bitztzeloteh. ella (Shmuel 1 1:13) rak sefateha naot vekolah lo yishshamea, uvehay raza (Bamidbar 3:10) vehazzar hakkarev yumat. vehachi baatztzilut (davar acher bitzlota) kol chad metztzalle bachashay, dela ishtema tzeloteh legabbe chavreh. kegon man dedarish lechavreh, veyashtik dibbur legabbeh, la tzarich lemebad ella dibbur bachashay, dela yishma chavreh. uvegin da okmuha rabbanan, kol hammashmia kolo bitfillato, 12 mikketanne amana.

Uvegin kach chevavn eshsha leella, memallelan keanpin deilana, dahavo mitkabbetztzin tamman, bemizmute chatan vechalla. bean atar. bekriat shema, detamman vaeshma et kol kanfehem. deinnun 64 led gadpin, 4 zimnin 64, sallekin 256. vehay ihu, (Yirmeyahu 31:7) rannu leyaakov simcha. ematay. levatar denatil nukema missanoy, veyokid taavavn dilhon, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 11:10) uvaavod reshaim rinna. ihu haner (sefer acher 40 shenin) leashlema amud bet amud bet, amud bet. vetalyayn 64.

Vetalyayn 64, min temanya 8. vehachi 64 mittemanya 8 led sitrin, 256. vechad mate 62, deinnun 8 8 8 8, deinnun 8 8 8 8, itchabbar 10 lechol setar, lemehevi 18 Adonai, bechy birchan ditztzelota, deit behon 18 zimnin Adonai, desallekin amud bet. behahu zimna demitchabbera Adonai baadonay bechay almin yeahdonahy, miyyad chevan deesh chashot. ma ketiv behon. (Yechezkel 1:24) beamdam terappena chanfehem, beamdam yisrael begaluta (nusach acher bitzlota), terappena chanfehem, dela yishtemodun ad hahi shaata.

Vehay ihu rak sefateha naot. deinnun kanfe hachayyot, vekolah lo yishshamea. ma dahavi chashmal, chevan eshsha memallelan, innun chashot. uvegin da takkinu tzelota bachashay, vehachi maase merkava bachashay, lemallela tamman bachashay, beno leven atztzemo. 3 tzelotin takkinu, uvechullehu 18 Adonai, deinnun amud bet atvavn, bechol tzelota, betamne sere birchan, deinnun 216, uchelilan bechesed, bev, im 32 netivot, vehayeynu 250 chaserin 2. dichlilan beammuda deemtztzaita.

Demikkarbena ishtema tzelota, tzelota mikkarbena. kegavvna deittemar behon, (Yechezkel 1:24) vaeshma et kol kanfehem. hachi bakkeruvim, (Bamidbar 7:89) vayyishma et hakkol middabber elav. kegavvna dechevesh sallekin venachtin beh karbenin veillavavn. hachi bitztzelota, malachin sallekin tere venachte tere. uchegavvna desinay, deveh moshe veaharon sallekin venachtin, sallekin teren venachtin 2. uvefikuda da, itremizu kol pikudin deorayyta.

1492: (Shmuel 1 2:4) keshet gibborim chattim. umissitra dimina, (Yechezkel 1:28) kemare hakkeshet asher yihye veanan beyom haggeshem. kad itchazi beyom haggeshem, achze rachame. vechad itchaze bela mitra, achze dina. meurav ben mitra veshimmesha, achze dina verachame kalil. vehay ihu 300 min shadday, telat anpe avahan, deinnun Adonai elohenu Adonai, telat shemahan lokovel telat anpe avahan. uvehon 14 atvavn, bechusheban 14 min shadday. ulevush deshadday, metatron, dehachi salik bechusheban shadday. Beyome derosh hashshana, metakkenin be dina kuresyay lemalka, lemedan kol alma. veyisrael alin bekadmita bedina kammeh, delifush rachame. (sefer acher kammeh delipposh rugeza) tenan umishpat ammo yisrael devar yom beyomo, yom beyomo may hu. ella hane tere yomin derosh hashshana. amay tere yomin. begin deinnun tere be dina, demitchabberan kachada. dina illaa, deihu kashya, bedina tattaa, deihu rafya, vetarvavyyhu mishtachche.

Veal da la yade hane bavlae, raza divava vilaluta, vela yade detarvavyyhu itzterichu, yelaluta deihu dina takkifa. telat tevirin deihu dina rafya, genuche ganach rafya. innun la yade, veavdin tarvavyyhu. vaanan yadenan, veavdenan tarvavyyhu. (sefer acher veal da raza divava vilala vetarvavyyhu itzterichu, hane bavlae, inun lo yade, veavdin tarvavyyhu.) vecholla nafkin leorach keshot.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 81:4) tiku vachodesh shofar bakkese leyom chagenu. tiku vachodesh shofar, may vachodesh. da be dina rafya, deikre chodesh. bakkese: (kes dealma ilaa, 80 Adonai da pachad yitzchak deihu kes lemalka ilaa, tu bakkese) da dina kashya, pachad yitzchak. dina deitkasyay tadir, delav ihu dina beitgalyay. ki chok, da dina rafya. umishpat, (da dina kashya) da dina berachame. vetarvavyyhu innun kachada. begin kach teren yomin, vetarvavyyhu beraza chada.

(Tehillim 89:16) ashre haam yode terua vegomer, la ketiv shome, o toke terua, ella yode terua. begin (sefer acher kegon) chakkimin dedayyrin baavira deara kadisha, innun yode terua. raza ditrua, kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 2:9) teroem beshevet barzel. man amma keyisrael, deyadin razin ilain demarehon, lemeal kammeh, uleitkkeshara beh. vechol innun deyade raza ditrua, yitkarvun lemehach beor panav dekudesha berich hu. veda or kadmaa deganiz kudesha berich hu letzaddikayyay. veal da itzterich leminda lah.

Ketiv (Vayikra 9:10) hayyoteret min hakkaved. uchetiv (Vayikra 3:4) veet hayyoteret al hakkaved. (batar deavidat niufa, istelik aleh.) yoteret min hakkaved, da eshet zenunim, deazla venafka min hakkaved, leastaa bene alma, uleastena alayyhu. veshavkat lidchura, lemebad zenunim. uvegin da hayyoteret min hakkaved, yoteret al hakkaved. batar deavdat niufa, istalakat aleh. metzach ishsha zona. itgabberat al balah deihu kaved, bechaas demara, eshet medanim, vachaas, deshalta ihi al dechura dilah. metzach ishsha zona shalta al hakkaved, eshet medanim vachaas.

Yoteret min hakkaved, min hakkaved nafka leavasha lechol alma, ulemebad niufin im kolla. levatar ihi salleka legabbe dechora, metzach ishsha zona, beazzuta deanpin, ucheden ihi al hakkaved. veod, yoteret min hakkaved itkeriat missitra achara, batar denafkat lenaafa im kolla, yehivat shiyyurin levalah, vehay ihi yoteret min hakkaved.

Miggo kaved, veyoteret dilah, nafkat mara, veihi charba demalach hammavt, denafku minnah tippin meriran lekatla bene nasha. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei Adonai:4) veacharitah mara challaana. veihi talya bakkaved, kol marin umota beh talyayn. vehahu yoma derosh hashshana (mashetanea) meshatteta bealma, lemichnash kol chove alma ucheden kol evarin deinnun yisrael, innun beaku, deinnun evare dematronita, (Mishlei 20:27) ner Adonai nishmat adam, shechinta kaddisha. ucheden kol yisrael beaku, venatle shofar leatteara beh hahu tekia ushevarim uterua.

Raya mehemna amar raya mehemana, vday batar deevarim vearkin delibba, dedamyayn leyisrael, innun beaku. tzerichin leatteara bekane, deihu shofar. veda kane derea. batar dechanfe rea la yachlin leshakkecha
1494: Rugeza demara deitgabbart al arkin delibba, veal kol arkin deevarim degufa. hahu rucha denashiv behon, salik bekane, deihu shofar, alma deate. dehachi okmuha, veshet, dome lealma den, deveh achila ushetiyya. kane, dome lealma deate, delet beh achila ushetiyya.

Ulevatar deshat 6 min veshet, beribbuy achila degezel itarach veitavid satan. uman garim da. (Bamidbar 11:8) shatu haam velaktu, shatuta dilhon deitarvu beerev rav shatyayn, detaava dilhon achila ushetiyya degezel vechamas, (Tehillim 12:6) deshod aniyyim veenkat evyonim. benun kefufa shatyayn, deachlin bela techina. ma ketiv behu, (Bamidbar 11:33) habbasar odennu ben shinnehem terem yikkaret veaf Adonai chara vaam. itpeshat 6 deshatu, ihu derucheh kafuf, veihu 50. veda garam deitpeshat satan baachila ushetiyya, veitgebar al kol evarin vearkin beshs lo taase. kechusheban hassatan chaser chad, da yom hakkippurim, delet beh achila ushetiyya.

Veihu kegavvna dekane, veihu 6 ben yah, min bina. uvegineh ukemuha mare matnitin, haroe kane bachalom, zoche lachachma. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 4:Adonai) kene chachma kene vina. delet kane deihu pachut mittarvavyyhu, deinnun 10 chachma, Adonai bina. uvegin da, tzarich leitteara bashshofar, deihu kane, alma deate, olam aroch, erech appayim, demishtakkeche minneh 13 mechilin derachame, kechushevan vav, 1 erech, 6 6 appayim.

Veimma illaa ihi tekia, missitra deavraham. shevarim, missitra deyitzchak. terua, missitra deyaakov. shechinta tattaa, kesher dechullehu. dehayynu: 100 tekia. 300 shevarim. Rabbi terua. vechullehu meshullashin legabbe shechinta, hada hu dichtiv, kedushsha lecha yeshalleshu. delet kala yachil lenafka levar, ella min happe. uf hachi, let leafresha shechinta min kudesha berich hu. dekudesha berich hu ittemar beh, (Tehillim 29:7) kol Adonai chotzev lahavot esh. ushechinta tefillat kol pe. veinnun simanin, 700 500 400. (74 kan).
Natlin shofar, leitteara beh, terua utekia, dina kashya berachame, ushevarim dina kashya bela rachame (sefer acher dina rafya berachame) ucheden hachi yittearu leella leitarva da beda.

Raya mehemna uvechibbura kadmaa, amar raya mehemana, behay itbesam satan, vekamit nun min veshet, ma dehava satan lefanim, tav laachora, veithaddar veshet, kidbekadmeta. begin dehakkol kol yaakov. yisrael let chelehon baachila ushetiyya, kishar ammin, deyartin alma den, dechelehon baachila ushetiyya. ella chelehon bekol da, deihu alma deate, olam aroch, deitbere beat yod, uvegin dekol shofar minneh nafik, amru rabbanan en pochatin measara shofarot. uveot 10 vadday, itavid olam aroch, deihu 6 alma deate uveat Adonai, bara alma den, deihi Adonai zeera, devah achila ushetiyya deorayyta.

Veod raza achara, batar deitgezar gezera bitren atvavn, deinnun Adonai Adonai, teren batte dinin, man yachil levattela gezera detarvavyyhu. 16. deat hei imma illaa. 10 av. uma ketiv, (Bamidbar 30:14) kol neder vechol shevuat issar leanot nafesh, deihi Adonai, ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu. uvegin da, tzarich leatteara kala deihu 6, baasara shofarot, deinnun 10. veikkara dilhon binshima achat, kol siman vesiman, bappe, deihi 10 measara.

Miyyad deshamu millin rabbi shimon vechol chavrayyay, amru, berich elaha dezachena lemishma millin, mehahu deitkere rabban shel neviim, rabban dachachamim, rabban demalache hashsharet, dekudesha berich hu ushechinteh medabber al pumoy, vechatav al yedoy razin illen, dela ishtemau kevavtayyhu mimmattan tora, vead kean.

Amar leh, botzina kaddisha, ashlim millule derazin dechibbura kadmaa, lefarsha lon, deha kol mare metivtan dilella, umare metivtan diltatta, kullehu mezumanin lemishma millin illen mippumach, ufirushin dilach. deha chedva ufurekana, yittear behon leella vetatta. al tittenu domi, lo ant, vechol siata dilach. Bitrua utekia ushevarim, itbesam kolla da beda. vechol ma dehahu kaved nakit, akriv legabbe lev, deihu malka, lezayyna (ledina). vehahu lev, lav orcheh, velav tiuveteh, baachiru deovadin deammeh. ella nakit kol beriru, vechol tzachuta,
1495: Vechol zachyayn, vechol ovadin tavin. vechol hahu achiru vetinufin velichlucha deinnun ovadin bishin, (sefer acher leta) (zarik lon lishar ammin ovde kochavim umazzalot hahu kaved) anach lechaved. deittemar beh, (Bereshit 27:11) esav ish sair. vechol arkin dileh, deinnun shear ammin ovde kochavim umazzalot. hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 16:22) venasa hassair alav et kol avonotam. may avonotam. avonot tam. deittemar beh, (Bereshit 25:27) veyaakov ish tam. vechovin deammuda (sefer acher deimmeh) deinnun arkin vedafkin delibba.

Uvegin da, shechin vetzaraat vesappachat, lechol innun evarin, mikkaved ishtechachu, meillen lichluchin deishtaaru beh. millibba ate kol beriuta, lechol evarin. dehachi hu, kevan delibba natil kol zechichu uverira vetzachuta. kaved natil kol ma deishtechach veishtear min lichlucha vetinnufa. vezarik lechol shear shayyfin, deinnun shear ammin ovde kochavim umazzalot acharanin, baal karchayyhu. umippesolot difssolet dechaved, natal techol, deittemar beh (Bereshit 1:14) yehi meorot. (Mishlei 3:33) meerat Adonai bevet rasha.

Raya mehemna od amar bechibbura kadmaa, amar raya mehemana, veha okmuha rabbanan aleh, techol sochek. veihu (Kohelet 7:6) sechok hakkesil. uvegin da, okmuha rabbanan dematnitin, oy lo lemi shehashshaa mesacheket lo. vekohelet amar (Kohelet 7:3) tov kaas missechok. tov kaas dechaved, deihi mara, retzua dekudesha berich hu, retzua lealkaa bah tzaddikayyay bealma den bemarin bishin, bemachteshin, missechok desachik lon batchol, belichlucha dehay alma, desochek lon shaata beutera. veod, eres ditchol ihu zechil afar, veihu takkif yattir meeres demara.

Uvegin deerev rav innun seor shebbaisa, veinnun umin dealma damyayn lemotz, yattir meakkevin begaluta erev rav leyisrael, meumin ovde kochavim umazzalot. kema deukemuha rabbanan, mi meakkev. seor shebbaissa meakkev. deinnun devekin beyisrael, kasseor baissa. aval umin ovde kochavim umazzalot, lav innun ella (Tehillim 1:4) kammotz asher tiddefennu ruach.

Veod (Vayikra 16:22) venasa hassair alav, kad reuteh lemebad kuretzya lekudesha berich hu im yisrael, deihu nasa kol chovin deyachil lemisbal lon, ad deitavid kaved, (Tehillim 38:5) kemassa chaved yichbedu mimmenu, chovin al gadpoy. me avid, salik letura illaa, kachamara kad ihu bae lesalleka letur gavoah, kemassa chaved yichbad aleh. kad ihu leella, uvae lesalleka lefi miut deishtear leh, ityekar aleh matula, venafil, veappil garmeh letatta, uvechoved massa deittekkaf aleh, itavidu kol evarin dileh peskot, dela ishtear ever shelim. uf hacha ira lesamael venachash, kaved veyoteret hakkaved, yetzer hara uvat zugeh zona. mittamman kol bat el nechar zona. Amar ribbi pinchas, orcha da hava metukkana li, lemishma millin illen meattik yomin, zakkaa alma deant share begavih. vavy lealma, deyishtaarun yatmin, vela yadin mille deorayyta kaddeka yaut. vday hachi hu, dechaved natil kolla tav uvish. veaf al gav dimshatteta velakit kol chovehon deyisrael, hachi name zachyayn dilhon lakit, begin lekayyeyma kuretzeh. vecholla hay vehay makriv legabbe lev. veorchoy delev, la natil ella zechichu uveriru vetzachuta decholla, kema deamart. ushear tinnufa velichlucha, ahdar lechaved, venatil kolla beal karcheh, dichtiv venasa hasair alav vegomer. milla da ahadarna, begin deyitbesam lefumi kemitka deduvesha, zakkaa chulaki dezachena lehay, lemechome da beenay.

Uf hu patach veamar, (Tehillim 131:1) Adonai lo gava libbi velo ramu enay vegomer, hay kera amar david, beshaata dehava azil al kef nahara, (vahava amar) ribbono shel olam, kelum hava bar nash bealma, deode umeshabbach lemareh kevavti. izdammenat leh tzefardea, amar leh, david, lo titgae, daana avdit yatir minach, demasarit gufay al memra demari, dichtiv (Shemot 7:28) vesharatz hayeor tzefardeim, veha ukemuha. vetu daana meshabbach umezammer lelya veyoma, bela shechichu. behahi shaata amar david, Adonai lo gava libbi velo ramu enay. Adonai lo gava libbi. (kan chaser)
Da hu karbena, divchol yoma, uvechol zeman uzeman, legabbe kudesha berich hu. deitkelilat cheneset yisrael beh, ben kol shear uchlusin, vechol illen pulechanin, appiku lah mibben guvin, umibben
1496: Shear ammin. kach yisrael, kol zeman deinnun atime libba, vela patchin betiyyuveta, la sallekin recha, vela appik lon miggo guvin. aval kad patchin betiyyuveta, miyyad sallekin recha, veyappik lon mibben guvin, veyithane behu keneset yisrael. dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:2) pitchi li achoti rayati. dechol zeman deshoshanna atima, let lah recha, vela salika mibben guvin, vediyyuraha benayyhu, kema deittemar. vekudesha berich hu la shadar lan lemehach orcha da, ella leolif millin illen.

Ad dahavo yatve, ata nishra, umaich, venatil chad shoshana mibbenayyhu, veazlat. amru, mikkan ulehala, nehach leorchin. kamu veazlu. ad hacha orcha deribbi pinchas, verabbi shimon azal leh, ihu veribbi elazar, ushear chavrayyay, veribbi pinchas ushear chavrayyay.

Patach veamar ribbi pinchas al ze, (Tehillim 60:1) lamnatztzeach al shushan edut michtam ledavid lelammed, may lelammed. leolfa livne alma chachmeta. veha okmuha, shushan edut, illen sanhedre gedola. dichtiv bah, (Shir HaShirim 7:3) suga bashshoshannim. michtam ledavid simana deachziu leh ledavid, kad shadar leyoav laaram naharayim ulearam tzova, leagacha behu. amar ribbi pinchas, da ihu shushan edut dekayyeyma hacha, ha kochavayya bishmayya, shechinta alan, vedargin illain bahadah, vesiyyayta kadisha letushebachta, da ihu shushan bishlimu kedka yeot. kamu veazlu. illen hacha veillen hacha. azal leh ribbi pinchas, uvat bichfar akimin, veribbi yitzchak veribbi chiyyay bahadeh.
Ad deakdimu lemezal, yatvu umechakku linhora detzafra, zakif enoy ribbi chiyyay, vechama illen kochavayay desharvita, deka merahatan veazlan. amar, vadday bechamma zimnin shaalna al illen kochavayay.

Amar ribbi pinchas, illen kochavayay desharvita yedian besucheltanu dechavrayyay, deha kudesha berich hu bara kol innun kochve rekia, ravrevin uzeirin. vechullehu odan umeshabbechan lekudesha berich hu. (dichtiv, 0 mone mispar lakkochavim) vechad mata zimnayyhu leshabbecha, kera lon kudesha berich hu bishma, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 40:26) lechullam beshem yikra. ucheden rahate, veoshitu sharvita dinhora, lemehach leshabbecha lemarehon, behahu atar deitpakdan. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 40:26) seu marom enechem ureu mi vara elle. vegomer. addehachi ata nehora, kamu veazlu.

Ad dahavo azle, ata nishra ravreva, aschar al reshayyhu, vekayyeyma alayyhu. amar ribbi pinchas, vday idan reuta hu hasheta, bah shaata, itpetachu tare derachame, lechol innun be mare, vehu zimna leasvavta lon. veaf al gav deinnun asirin lemalka (sefer acher demalka). deha nishra da simana derachame ihu.

Patach veamar, (Devarim 32:11) kenesher yair kinno al gozalav yerachef vegomer. lekka bealma man deihu berachame al benoy kenishra, veha ukemuha dichtiv, (Mishlei 30:17) veyochluha vene nesher, deihu rachamana al benoy. umiggo dehashta idan derachame, ata nishra da veaschar alana. beshaata da ihu rachame, lechol innun be mare. veda ihu dichtiv, (Tehillim Adonai:4) Adonai boker tishma koli. veda boker deavraham, veitaruta dileh.

Addehachi, aschar nishra veabar lekamayyhu. amar ribbi pinchas, nishra nishra, ma ant legabban, i bishlichuta demarach atit, ha anan hacha. i begin milla (sefer acher simana) achara atita, ha anan hacha zeminin. itram nishra leella, veitkasse minnayyhu, veinnun yatvu.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, ha dishlomo malka zuteratti (sefer acher tayvahea) hu, detanenan, nishra ravreva hava ate legabbeh shelomo malka bechol yoma veyoma, vahava shelomo malka rachiv al gadfaha, veovil leh 4 mea parse beshaata chada. lean ovil leh letarmod bammidbar beharim. atar kad ihu, legabbe ture dachashocha, deikre (Melachim 1 9) tarmod bammidbar velav ihu atar detarmodae, ella tarmod deihu bammidbar beharim, vetamman mitkanneshe kol ruchin vesitrin acharanin. vehahu nishra hava tas letaman, beshaata chada.

Kevan dekaim al hahu ducheta, agba nishra, ushelomo katav pitka, vearme tamman, veishteziv meinnun ruchin. venishra hava mistakkal go chashocha deturin, laatar detamman aza veazael, deinnun tamman asirin beshalshelae defarzela, neitzan go tehome. velet yachilu (sefer acher reshu) lebar nash bealma
