Vechevan denishra mistakkal go chashocha ravreva, maich letatta, venatil leh lishlomo malka techot gadfaha semala, umechasseyay leh. vekayyeyma al illen shalshelae, veazla umekarva legabbayyhu, ushelomo keden appik izka, (shaverateygea) dechakik aleh shema kadisha, veshavvi befuma denishra. umiyyad, innun havo amre, kol ma devae shelomo malka, umittamman hava yada shelomo chachmeta (ilaa). hada hu dichtiv, (Melachim 1 9:18) vayyiven vegomer et tarmod bammidbar baaretz. vechi binyayna hava avid baaretz. ella mahu vayyiven. istekal besachletanu, veyada lehahu ducheta, leminda beh chachmeta. (ilaa kema deat amar 3 veyavinu bammikra).

Ad dahavo yatve, ha nishra atya legabbayyhu, veshoshanna chada befumah, veshade kammayyhu, veazlat lah, chamu vechadu. amar ribbi pinchas, velav amena lechu, denishra da bishlichuta demarah, azla veatya. shoshana da, ihi shushan edut dekaamena, vekudesha berich hu shadar leh legabban.

Patach kemillekaddemin veamar, (Tehillim 60:1) lamnatztzeach al shushan edut michtam ledavid lelammed. vechi shushan edut may sahaduta sahid. ella shushan da ihi sahaduta lemaase bereshit, veihi sahaduta lechneset yisrael. sahaduta leyichuda illaa, veda ihu. begin deshoshanna da it bah telesar alin, vechullehu kayymin beikara chada, veit bah chamesh alin levar takkifin, dechafyayn leda shoshana veagginu alah.

Vecholla beraza dechachmeta hu, telesar alin, illen telesar mechilan derachame, deyarta keneset yisrael milleella, vechullehu achidan beikara chada, (davar acher deinnun 13 tikkunin dadeykenaa tattaa dearich anpin, deinnun 13 tikkunin illain dizer anpin) veihu berit chada vedugema divrit (sefer acher yichuda) yesoda decholla. chamesh takkifin desacharan aleh, illen chamshin tarin, chamesh mea shenin (diysoda, yesoda 2 berit kaddisha) deilana dechayye, azla behu.

Sahaduta leovada divreshit. kol ovada divreshit, kullehu (sefer acher chamesh mea shenin diysoda berit kaddisha kullehu ovada divreshit tayyvin vechulei) tevin yedian besucheltanu, vekayyeyma bechushebana elohim demaase bereshit. achze leella, veachze letatta. achze leella, beraza dealma deate. veachze letatta, beraza dichneset yisrael.

Shoshana sahaduta leovada divreshit, dekayyeyma bechol hane simanin, dichtiv (sefer acher da) bereshit bara elohim, da shoshana. telesar alin, (nusach acher inun) telesar tevin ad elohim tinyayna. veinnun: et, hashshamayim, veet, haaretz, vehaaretz, hayta, tohu, vavohu, vechoshech, al, pene, tehom, veruach. ha telesar alin deshoshanna. chamesh takkifin desacharan leillen, innun: merachefet, al, pene, hammayim, vayyomer. ha chamesh acharanin. levatar yehi or, ha ikkara vesharsha deshoshanna decholla vaachidan bah.

Sahaduta leyichuda. chamesh alin takkifin, sharsha veyichuda, daachidan beh telesar alin illen. (Devarim 6:4) shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai, ha chamesh alin deshoshanna. echad, da hi ikkara vesharsha dechullehu achidan beh. raza (sefer acher sahaduta laychavedaa. chamesh tevin shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai, inun chamesh alin takkifin dashevashenah. sharsha visoda achidan beh da hu echad, veihu ikara vesharsha dechullehu achidan beh. telesar alin illen raza) ditlesar bechushebana, gushepanka demalka.

Ta chaze, kegavvna (Shir HaShirim 2) deshoshanna ben hachochim, hachi innun yisrael ben ammin ovde kochavim umazzalot. vehachi keneset yisrael, ben shear uchlusin ravrevan memanan. kol zeman deshoshanna kayyeyma atima, dela peticha, let bah recha, vela sallekin lah, vela mafkin lah miggo guvin, beshaata deshoshanna peticha, salleka recha, keden appiku lah miggo guvin. veyithane behu keneset yisrael, shenneemar (Shir HaShirim Adonai:2) pitchi li achoti rayati, vekudesha berich hu la shadrah lan ella lemehach leorchan.
Amar ribbi elazar laavuhi, ha shemana illen shayyfin atimin, beraza dekarbenin. shayyfin acharanin, raza dilhon may. amar leh ribbi
Raya mehemna uvechibbura kadmaa, amar raya mehemana, butztzina kadisha, kol ma deamart shappir, aval mocha ihu mayim, lev ihu esh, vetarvavyyhu ihu rachame vedina, da
1498: Shimon leribbi elazar, elazar beri, kol shear shayyfin dilgo, raza illaa ihu.

Ta chaze, libba ha ittemar, aval lev da ihu nura dedalik, veilmale dezammin legabbeh malka illaa kanfe rea, deatyayn lekammeh rucha, merucha denashiv miggo busemin illain, hava okid lealma beriga chada.

Patach veamar, (Bereshit 19:24) vaAdonai himtir al sedom veal amora gafrit vaesh, amay okid lon. begin dechanfe rea la neshivu behahi shaata. vesitra dechanfe rea, da (Tehillim 68:14) kanfe yona nechpa vakkesef veinnun refael, vetzadkiel. vealayyhu ittemar, (Tehillim 104:4) ose malachav ruchot, lenashva tadir kamme malka (sefer acher lavo).
Kisse rachame, veda kisse dina. vekudesha berich hu melech, omed mikkise din, deihu lev. veyoshev al kisse rachamim, deihu mocha.

Vechad chovin mitrabbin al evarim, veal arkin delibba, deihu kurseyay dedina. ittemar belibba, (Ester 7:7) vehammelech kam bachamato mimmishte hayyayin, deihu yina deorayyta. uvezimna dechanfe rea nashvin al libba, (Yechezkel 1:24) vaeshma et kol kanfehem (Ester 7:10) vachamat hammelech shachacha. ditren kanfe rea, (Shemot 28) vehayu hakkeruvim porse chenafayim lemala sochchim bechanfehem al hakkapporet, da kapporta delibba.

Uvemay vachamat hammelech shachacha. begin devaeshma et kol kanfehem (Bamidbar 7:89) vayyishma et hakkol, da kol tora, kol dikriat shema. vaydabber elav, bitztzelota defuma, deihu (Tehillim 51:17) adonay sefatay tiftach ufi yaggid tehillatecha.

Vehahu rucha denashiv bechanfe rea, ihu appik kala bekane, deihu kene chachma kene vina. veittemar bah, (Yechezkel 37:9) ko amar Adonai mearba ruchot boi haruach. deinnun arba atvavn Adonai, vehay ihu ruach dedafik bechol arkin delibba, deittemar behon, (Yechezkel 1:12) el asher yihye shamma haruach lalechet yilechu.

Amar butztzina kadisha, vadday raya mehemana, darga dilach ihi, deveh vachamat hammelech shachacha. (Tehillim 144:15) ashre haam shekkacha, begimatriyya moshe. amar leh, berich ant butztzina kadisha, butztzina dedalik kamme malka umatronita. ner Adonai, ihi neshama dilach.

Amar leh, ha amrat mocha velibba vechanfe rea, tere kuleyayn may nihu. amar raya mehemana, ha okimna bechanfe rea, ose malachav ruchot, kulleyayn meshartav esh lohet. veinnun teren kanfe rea, uteren kulleyayn, lokovel 4 chevan dechurseyay. kurseyay, ihu libba beemtztzaita.

Vechen mocha, it leh arba chevan, deihu kurseyay derachame. umay nihu. reiyyay shemia recha dibbur. reiyyay: aryi. shemia: shor. recha: nishra. ved anpin ved kanfin lechol chad. dibbur: adam ihu. achid ella vetatta, deroin divhon veyadenu perusot kenishre shamayim. guf aryi, veshokayim, (Yechezkel 1:7) vechaf raglehem kechaf regel egel. veal gufa ittemar, (Bereshit 41:43) merkevet hammishne. mishna ketiv, lishana dematnitin. (ad kan raya mehemana).

Techol, patach butzina kadisha veamar, (Kohelet 4:1) vaere et kol haashukim shennaasu tachat hashshamesh vehinne dimat haashukim. man innun ashukim. illen yannukin deinnun betukepa deimmehon. desallekin mealma, al yede malach hammavt. vechi malach hammavt katil lon, deihu oshek. ella hadar veamar, umiyyad oshkehem koach veen lahem menachem. man hahu koach. da hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:14) yehi meorot birkia hashshamayim. veda hu meorot chaser vav, veda lilit, deihi memana dehahu oshek.

Veihi ikre techol, veihi azlat (mishpatim 114) vechayycha beyannuke, uvatar avdat behu rugeza vedima, lemivke alayyhu. techol lezina dechaved azla. da ivre bashsheni, veda barvii beovada divreshit. uvegin da, let simana tava bashsheni uvarvii. kaved mota deravreve, techol mota dezutere.

Raya mehemna uvechibbura kadmaa, amar raya mehemana, vday hachi hu, dechaved ihu darga deesav. esav hu edom. hu kanish kol damin, ben tzelulin, ben achurin. velo avchin ben tav levish. la avid afrashuta benayyhu. libba ihu yisrael, deavchin ben tav levish, ben dam tame ledam tahor, vela natil ella beriru venakyu dehahu dama, kevorer ochel miggo pesolet.
Ulevatar denatil libba, deihu yaakov, beriruta dedamim, deihu leella. veishtear kaved deihu
1499: Esav bippesolet. ihu kais aleh bemara, deihi gehinnam, deitberiat beyoma tinyayna, mota deravreve, veihi nukeva bisha, esh zara, avoda kasha, avoda zara karenan lah.

Uvegin deminah itar kaas lechaved, okmuha rabbanan bematnitin, kol hakkoes keillu oved avoda zara. velo od, ella delet serefa vachamimut bechol marin deevarin degufa, ella mimmara. deihi adlikat beshalhovin al arkin dechaved, uvae leokda kol gufa. veihu kegavvna deyamma, kad ihu kais, degalle yamma sallekin ad rekia, uvau lenafka miggevulayyhu, letavra (sefer acher lecharba) alma. i lav shechinta, deihi lachole kechol deaschar leyamma, dela nafkat mippumaha, uf hachi shechinta ascharat legufa, vesamich leh, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 41:4) Adonai yisadennu al eres devay.

Uvegin da ukemuha mare matnitin, hammevakker et hachole, la letiv lemeraashotav, mishshum dishchinta al resheh. vela leragloy demalach hammavt leragloy. hay lav lechol bar nash, ella labbenoni. aval latztzadik gamur, Adonai yisadennu al eres devay, al resheh. ushechinta aschar gufeh, ad ragloy. uvegin da ittemar beyaakov, (Bereshit 49:33) vayyeesof raglav el hammitta, veda shechinta deittemar bah, (Yeshayahu 66:1) vehaaretz hadom raglay. lerasha gamur, malach hammavt aschar leh bechol sitra. veda yetzer hara, demalach hammavt aschar leh bechol sitra, charva dileh, defanav morikot, betifa chada meinnun 3 tippot, dezarik beh. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei Adonai:4) veacharitah mara challaana. kaved da dechura. yoteret hakkaved nukeva. (74 kan).

Keva, ihu darga chad mishshittin demota. veda itkere tardema. astira (nusach acher aseyretaa), darga shetitaa demalach hammavt. umiggo deate merachik, ihu missitra demota. velav mota. ramza, chad mishshittin demota.

Raya mehemana amar raya mehemana, batar degufa ihu meilana detov vara, let ever begufa, dela it beh yetzer hara veyetzer tov, labbenoniyyim. velatztzaddikim gemurim, teren yetzirot, doddechar venukeva, tarvavyyhu tovim. kegavvna dechatan vechalla. larshaim gemurim, teren yetzirot bishin, dechar venukeva, bechol ever veever, missitra desamael venachash.

Uvegin da missitra deilana detov vara, keva it bah teren dargin. dehachi okmuha rabbanan, keva yashen. veit shena, achat mishshittin bemota. veshena, achat mishshittin bannevua. uvegin da okmuha rabbanan mare metivta, (Zecharya 10) hachalomot shav yedabberu, vehachtiv (Bamidbar 12:6-7) bachalom adabber bo. la kashya, kan al yede shed. kan al yede malach. chalom al yede malach, chad mishshittin bannevua. chalom al yede shed, ihu shav, missitra demota. veihu teven, dehachi okmuha, keshem shei efshar levar belo teven, kach i efshar lachalom belo devarim betelim.

Itztomcha da kurkevan niklaf. veokmuha rabbanan, kurekvan tochen, deihu natil kolla, veshochek, umeshadder lechol evarin. i evarin bela chovin, kegavvna deokmuha rabbanan, deit millin dimakkevin yat karbena, dela nachit lekabbela leh, hahu deshaddar kudesha berich hu lekabbela dorona dileh. deit dimkabbel leh kudesha berich hu al yede arye, deittemar beh (Yechezkel 1:10) ufene arye el hayyamin learbatan. vekudesha berich hu rachiv aleh, venachit beh, lekabbela hahu dorona. veit dorona dimkabbel leh al yede shor, deittemar beh (Yechezkel 1:10) ufene shor mehassemool learbatan.

Veit dorona, dimkabbel al yede denesher, deittemar beh (Yechezkel 1:10) ufene nesher learbatan. deinnun shete torim, o shene bene yona. veit dorona, dimkabbel leh al yede deadam dichtiv beh, (Vayikra 1:2) adam ki yakriv mikkem karban laAdonai. bediyyukena dehahu deittemar beh. (Yechezkel 1:10) udemut penehem pene adam. Adonai nachit alayyhu, lekabbela dorona.

Veit chevan tiviot, memanan al gufin, deinnun mearba yesodin, veinnun dachyayn. velokovlayyhu arba chevan dorsin, misavin, (nusach acher malachin memanan) al 4 meriran, deinnun: mara chivvavra, mara sumaka, mara yeroka, mara uchama.

Veit chevan sichliot, desacharin lechurseyay. veit leella minnayyhu, ugevohim alehem, veinnun chevan elahiyyot, missitra dikdushsha. veit chevan desitra ochora. veitkeriu elohim acherim. veelahiyyot dekudesha, elohim chayyim. veillen elahiyyot dikdushsha, itkeriu elohe haelahiyyot, veillat al kolla, el adon al kol hammaasim. vechol zina azil lezineh. uvegin deit elohim acherim, amar alayyhu, (Shemot 22:19) zoveach laelohim yochoram bilti laydod levaddo. begin dela yitarev elohim chayyim im elohim acherim. (sefer acher uvechibbura kadmaa) (74 kan)
1500: Itztomcha da, natil veshachik, umeshadder lechol sitrin diltatta, uminneh itzanu tattae. meinnun shatin shemarim letatta, kol innun ruchin vesitrin acharanin deitzanu belelya, meinnun evarim ufedarim. ushear natlin kol shayyfin, venatil kolla kaved, vekariv lallev, kama deittemar. veda ihu dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:10) ufene arye el hayyamin. veal da itchaze al madbecha, kegavvna dearye achil karbenin. mikkan ulehala kol shear shayyfin, beraza degufa kegavvna dilella.

Raya mehemna amar raya mehemana, butzina kadisha, vadday itztomcha bekadmita natil kolla, ad shit shatin, veofe. kurkevan, ihu ofe. verea, ihi mashke. libba malka. veinnun teren, innun vadday ofe umashke, lemehav lemalka, mishshepiru dechol maachalin umashkin, resha dechullehu, mivchar lechullehu. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:1) ariti mori im besami achalti yari im divshi shatiti yeni im chalavi. levatar, ichlu reim, shear evarim, deinnun chelin umashiryayn demalka, defalig lon mezona, al yede sar haofim. shetu veshichru dodim, al yede sar hammashkim.

Vechaved ihu limina debar nash. uvegin da, ufene arye el hayyamin learbatan limina demalka, deihu liva. techol, lismala. illen innun missitra achara, ufene shor mehassemool. mashke chamra mazug bemayya lemalka. vearye achil, da kaved, kanish mezona kamme malka, deihu libba.

Veit leakshuye al hay. i kaved ihu esav, ech hu metakken mezona lelibba. ella vaday libba ihu kegavvna deyitzchak. kaved esav, deihu hatztzad tzayid. veyemma leh, (Bereshit 17) yakum avi veyochal mitztzed beno. illen innun tzelotin, deazlin umittarchin meaniyyim, veyitzchak betzaara uvigona, dela yachlin lechavvevna litzlota. uvegin da la amar veyochal mitztzedi, ella veyochal mitztzed beno. (Shemot 4) beni vechori yisrael. kegavvna da, let lon leyisrael mezona begaluta, ella al yede umin dealma.

Aval kad innun beara deyisrael, mezonehon al yede shechinta. veyehon teren kanfe rea mashkin uma, sar hammashkim. uteren kuleyayn haofim, dimvashshelin hazzera denachit min mocha, umevashlin mayya dimkabbelin mikkanfe rea. ulevatar deyechul malka, deihu libba, ittemar bitren kulleyayn dileh, ichlu reim. velitren kanfe rea, shetu veshichru dodim.

Delibba ihu kisse din, arba chevan shelichan dileh. teren kanfe rea, uteren kulleyayn, dechanfe rea ufenehem vechanfehem perudot millemala, lekabbela alayyhu malka, deihu (Yeshayahu 11:2) ruach chachma uvina ruach etza ugevura ruach daat veyirat Adonai. deyativ al kurseyay, deihu libba, dechol innun defikin mitnahagin abbatreh, kechayyaylin batar malchehon.

Verucha denashiv mikkanfe rea, nashiv al tere nukeve chotama. veihu karir utzenina missemola. vecham mimina. umissitra democha deihu kurseyay derachame, ihu ruach kar limina, dechesed. vecham missemala digvura, detamman libba. umocha mazig beh, beemtzaita detarvavyyhu. uf hachi libba mazig, mikkor vachom. umocha uf hachi, dimkabbelin den midden.

Ushemarim decholla, natil techol, umashiryayn dileh, deinnun avadim ushefachot, deamar alayyhu shelomo, (Kohelet 2:7) kaniti li avadim ushefachot. teren kuleyayn itkeriu ishim, al shem ishim dilella, deittemar behu (Devarim 18:1) ishshe Adonai venachalato yochelun.

Uvakkane shit izkan, dealayyhu ittemar, (Tehillim 29:1) havu laAdonai bene elim. divhon salik kala, deitpelig lev kalin dishchinta. usheviaa salik lefuma, deihu kurseyay. veshit izkan dekane, innun kegavvna deshit dargin dechurseyay demalka. vekane ihu sullam, deveh (Bereshit 28:12) malache elohim olim veyordim bo, deinnun havalim sallekin beh malka (nusach acher millavo), veruchin daavira (chorin nafkin) nachtin beh belibba, lekarra chamimuta, dela lokid gufa.

Vechad rucha nachit, nachit bechamma ruchin, kemalka im cheleh. vechanfe rea mekabbelin lerucha, deihu malka alayyhu, kema daamena. (Yechezkel 1:8) ufenehem vechanfehem perudot, (Shemot 25:20) vehayu hakkeruvim porse chenafayim lemala.

I zakkan evarin devar nash befikkudin daase demalka illaa deihu ruach hakkodesh, nachit besullam, deihu garon, bechamma ruchin kadishin, deittemar alayyhu, (Tehillim 104:4) ose malachav ruchot vesallekin lokovel illen havalim delibba, deittemar alayyhu, meshartav esh lohet. vealayyhu ittemar (Tehillim 29:7) kol Adonai chotzev
1501: Lahavot esh. begin delibba adonay, deminneh sallekin lahavot esh befuma deihu Adonai, denachtin immeh kama ruchin dikdushsha, mearba atvavn Adonai. deittemar alayyhu, (Yechezkel 37:9) ko amar Adonai mearba ruchot boi haruach.
Kane, ihu kene chachma kene vina, deinnun limina dechesed, velismala digvura. tiferet, sullam beemtzaita, begufa kalil teren deroin, veguf uverit, uteren (sitrin) shokin. lokovel shit izkan dekane.

Vechad nachit Adonai leliva, legabbe adonay, mitchabberin dina berachame belibba. deihu yeahdonahy. vechad salik adonay lefuma, daadonay sefatay tiftach, lekabbela Adonai befuma, leitchabbera tamman teren shemahan bechibbura chada, yeahdonahy, kegavvna demitchabberaan belibba. uvegin da okmuha mare matnitin, mi sheen tocho kevaro al yikkanes levet hammidrash, i let lon puma velibba shavin. (74 kan).

Kane shit izkan bekane, mitchabberan kachada, veinnun ikrun bene elim, mappeke rucha lenashva al alma. veatyayn missitra digvura. vechad innun mitchabberan kachada, innun kegavvna deshofar. veillen ikru shofar, shofar shel ayil shel yitzchak. elim bene bashan, havu laAdonai bene elim. elim deyitzchak, umappekin rucha vekala. vehahu kala nafik, veira beave mitra, veishtema leviryayta levar. veal da ketiv, (Iyov 26:14) veraam gevurotav mi yitbonan. devdai missitra digvura ka atyayn. uvegin da (sefer acher uma amar hahu 131, kol Adonai al hammayim el hakkavod vegomer) el hakkavod hirim Adonai al mayim rabbim. el hakkavod roem la ketiv, ella el hakkavod hirim, al yeda divne elim. velet man deyada bishvacha dehay kala, hada hu dichtiv mi yitbonan.

Raya mehemna uvechibbura kadmaa, patach raya mehemana veamar, vavy lon livne nasha, deinnun atimin libba, setimin ayynin, dela yadin evarim degufehon al ma innun mittakkenin, deha kudesha berich hu (nusach acher 155) telat chelin kelilan beh, chad hevel, deihu lahav esh, denafik min libba veitpelag lez havalim, deamar kohelet. tinyayna, avvir deal legabbeh millevar. telitaa, mayim dechanfe rea, deinnun devukim bekane. umittelat illen itavid kol, mayim veruach veesh, umitpeleg kol chad lez, veinnun 7 lehavim, 7 avirot, 7 nechalim.

Vechad arau lehavim delibba, beave mitra, deinnun kanfe rea, orach kane derea. hay ihu veraam gevurotav mi yitbonan. deveh lev mevin babbina, deihi belibba lismala, gevura. vechesed limina, mayim dechanfe rea. vetamman chachma mocha, uminneh, (Shir HaShirim 4:15) mayan gannim beer mayim chayyim venozlim min levanon. deihu libbuna democha, nozlim al kane derea. batar deistalaku ananim devina legabbe mocha.

Veraza demilla (Shir HaShirim 3:6) mi zot ola min hammidbar ketimrot ashan. veda ashan hamaaracha, desalik min libba lemocha. dechol ruchin dealma, la zazin leh meatreh. chachma: koach 45. koach: belibba. ma: bemocha. kane: tiferet, kalil 6 sefiraan. 6 dargin innun lechurseyay, deihi imma. lenachta chachma legabbah, min mocha lelibba, devah lev mevin. uvegin da, (Mishlei 4:Adonai) kene chachma kene vina. beh abba nachit. beh abba salik. vehay ihu sullam deveh (sefer acher olim veyordim bo) olim tere, veyordim tere. (ad kan raya mehemana).

Veshet devala mechla, umittamman al lechullehu shayyfin, deihi (sefer acher da ihu raza) bedarga deishshim. ishshim innun kerevin miyyad, uvale venatle kalil (sefer acher kolla) miggo eshsha illaa, dechalil laishshim. veraza da, (Devarim 18:1) ishshe Adonai venachalato yochelun. illen achlin uvalin, ushear la achlin hachi.

Vechol bene alma (sefer acher levar) levad, la yadin ech achlin, velav raza dilhon, ella dargin dilgo innun yadin, venatlin minnayyhu. veshet let leh bedika mibbachutz, dela yade, ella mibbifnim yade venatle ad deal leve tochna, veishtechik veitbeshal. venatil kolla kaved kema deittemar. meillen eshim nafke dargin, deakdeme venatle mikkaved bekadmita, (uman inun, illen) hatochanot, achle karbenin vetachane. veal da miditcharav be makdesha ketiv, (Kohelet 12:3) uvatlu hattochanot ki mietu. illen tachanin bekadmita.
Kevan deittachanan, innun deshalte alayyhu, bale venatle, veikrun veshet. amay. ella veshet, diyyukena devav,
1502: Ihu veshet kafuf. ulevatar, shat lemechal mishteya, chamra umaya. dichtiv, (Bamidbar 11:8) shatu haam velaktu. mechla lemechal, mishteya chamra umaya, nissucha deyayin, venissucha demayim.

Behay veshet al vishteiv barea, illen serafim, (sefer acher shayyfin) beshalhovita dilhon natle mishteya, veikrun rea, bechibbura chada, veishteiv kolla behon. vechol illen, natlin kol chad vechad, kaddeka chaze leh. umiddecharav be makdesha, (Kohelet 12:3) uvatlu hattochanot ki mietu kullehu. deaziru diyyukenayyhu umezonayyhu, velet yoma delet beh meera, arim kaleh rabbi shimon veamar, vavy yerushalam karta kadisha, vavy leamma, dechol tavan illen avdin, ravrevan gibbarin memanan aziru diyyukenayyhu, al da bachu chavrayyay. amru, vavy ribbi, kad tistallak min alma, man yegalle razin setimin amikin keillen, dela ishtemau min yoma dishlomo malka, vead hasheta. zakkaa dara deshamin millin illen, vezakkaa dara deant begavvivy, vavy ledara deyishtaarun yatmin minach.

Raya mehemna uvechibbura kadmaa patach raya mehemana veamar, veha ketiv, vesiftotenu shevach kemerchave rakia. vesheva rekiin innun: vilon. rakia. shechakim. zevul. maon. machon. aravot. shechakim. divhon rechayim detochanim man latzadikim leatid lavo. veinnun ikrun shechakim, al shem (Shemot 30:36) veshachakta mimmenna hadek, veinnun netzach vehod, alayyhu ittemar (Yeshayahu 45:8) ushechakim yizzelu tzedek, deihi shechinta tattaa.

Vilon, deveh machnis arvit umotzi shacharit. rakia, ihu yesod. deveh naharin shimsha vesihara, deihu ammuda deemtzaita ushechinta tattaa. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:17) vayyitten otam elohim birkia hashshamayim lehair al haaretz. vetzadik ot, ben netzach vehod. veedut, ben tiferet umalchut.
Netzach vehod teren palge gufa innun, kegavvna ditren teomim. uvegin da itkeriu shechakim. tarvavyyhu kachada 12 innun, min veshet, missitra dismala. veinnun teren tochanot, missitra dimina.

(Shemot 13:19) vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef immo. atzmot tzadik yesod almin, darga deyosef hatztzadik. vealayyhu ittemar, et karbani lachmi leishshay. velet lechem, ella orayyta, (Mishlei 9:Adonai) lechu lachamu belachmi. veinnun: ashkelot detzadik. vetzadik, etz peri. uvegineh ittemar, (Bamidbar 13:23) vayyissauhu vammot bishnayim. vaamay vammot. begin dela hava tamman tzadik.

Uveginayyhu ittemar beh, (Tehillim 55:23) lo yitten leolam mot latztzaddik, deihu etz, deittemar beh, (Bamidbar 13:20) hayesh bah etz im ayin. akeru etz deihu tzadik, illen deappiku shum bish al ara, vegarmu, vayyissauhu vammot bishnayim, 6 6.

Alayyhu ittemar, sachata anavim. tzadik yesod, beh sod, deihu yayin hameshummar baanavav mishsheshet yeme bereshit. deinnun 6 dargin deat 6. veinnun serafim, 6 6, (Yeshayahu 6:2) shesh kenafayim leechad. missemala. veinnun appiku mayim mimina. vetzachin beshalhovita dilhon missitra digvura, veshoavin missitra dechesed.

Vealayyhu ittemar, (Tehillim 104:4) ose malachav ruchot, missitra deammuda deemtzaita, denashvin al libba, deihu darga ashiraa berucha dekudesha, deihu benayyhu. veihu 6, ot betzava dileh, kalil 6 pirkin ditren shokin, dichtiv behu (Shir HaShirim Adonai:15) shokav ammude shesh, veda tzadik ot berit.

6 Illaa, tiferet. ben shit pirkin ditren deroin. uvegin da, 6 6, guf uverit chashvenan chad. veinnun (Shemot 25:20) porse chenafayim lemala, lekabbel 6 illaa alayyhu. umissitreh, itkeriu nevie haemet. sochchim bechanfehem al berit, deihu 6 tinyayna, (Mishlei 10:25) vetzaddik yesod olam. uvegin da, netzach vehod, tochanim man letzadikayyay, deinnun missitra detzaddik yesod olam, deihu benayyhu. uvegin da itkeriu tochanot.

Umissitra devshet, (Bamidbar 11:8) shatu haam velaktu, innun lekutot defiskot dematnita. vetachanu varechayim, mehacha, man deafik millin deorayyta, tzarich lemitchan lon beshinayim, uleappaka millin shelemin, veinnun millin itkeriu shelamim. veocharanin, deinnun shatyayn, deachlin millin behaleata, vela tochanin lon battochanot dilhon uveshinnehon, ma ketiv behu, (Bamidbar 11:33) habbasar odennu ben shinnehem veaf Adonai chara vaam, deinnun, miggiza deman deamar (Bereshit 25:30) haleiteni na. venetzach vehod itkeriu keruvim.
Utemanya innun: chachma, bina, gedula, gevura, tiferet, malchut, netzach, hod, tzaddik, atara al resheh. deihu let leh zug. umay atara dileh. keter elyon. uvegineh
1503: Okmuha mare matnitin, haolam habba en bo lo achila velo shetiyya ella tzaddikim yoshvim veatrotehem berashehem. vehayeynu deokmuha, amra shabbat kamme kudesha berich hu, lechullehu yome natatta ben zug veli lo natatta ben zug. (ad kan raya mehemana) (raya mehemana 213 amud alef)

Patach rabbi shimon veamar, (Devarim 6:4) shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad. 70 ravreva, 4 uf hachi. vesimana da ed. hayeynu dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 12:5) ed Adonai bachem. ishtaarun atvavn 340, 40 petucha. may tama la setima, begin dem setima, malka (sefer acher alma) illaa. 40 peticha, malka (sefer acher alma) tattaa. atvavn acharanin, ishtaaru 9, (Mishlei 25:2) kevod elohim haseter davar ketiv.

Ashkachna besifra derav hamenuna sava, kol man dimyayched yichuda da bechol yoma, chedva zemina leh milleella, meraza deatvavn illen, 340 mehay sitra. 9, mehay sitra. umetzaref atvavn, lemafrea (shadday) share, uvemeshar (chayyim) siyyem. vesiman esmach. dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:34) anochi esmach baAdonai. mammash. da yichuda kadisha. veshappir ihu. vehachi hu besifra dechanoch, deamar ki hay gavvna, deman dimyayched yichuda da bechol yoma, chedva zemina leh milella.

Tu it beh 340, deitkelil min 70 ravreva. illen shivin shemahan beraza daavahan kadishin, veda hu shema: shem 70. yisrael, Adonai, elohenu, Adonai, illen arba batte ditfillin, deachid lon 9. hahu deamar (Shir HaShirim Adonai:2) pitchi li achoti rayati. 4: da kesher shel tefilin, dehi achidat behu. raza lechakkimin itmesar, dela legallaa. shatik ribbi shimon. bacha vechayich, amar, emma, deha vadday raava ishtechach, velet kedara da ad deyete malka meshicha, diyhe reshu lon legallaa.

Teren retzuin nafkin, missitra da umissitra da, raza ditren yarchin diltatta dehay 9, dinvie keshot achidan behu. deha milleella nafkin teren retzuin, raza ditren deroin, mimina umissemala, vedalet itachidat behu. levatar nachta, veitpeshatu yarchin letatta. kevan dehi itachidat leella kaddeka yaut, nachta letatta, leitachada beuchlusaha. vechad ihi itachadat, achida beshippule yarchin, ureshimu deyod berit kaddisha alah milleella, keden ihi itachadat beyichuda chad.

Yod da ihi raza divrit, (veal da) kol man denatar berit da, ihu ishteziv leella, veishteziv letatta. (mena lan) pinchas, begin deihu kanne al berit da, ishteziv min dina illaa, umin dina diltatta, uvegin kach itreshim yod da begavvivy, hada hu dichtiv, pinchas ben elazar ben aharon hakkohen vegomer.

Yod da, itzterich dela yitade kelal miggo tefilla deyad, dela yabid piruda. vechol chedva dilah, behay 10. ihu yod da bidchura ihi, vela benukeba, ihu tzaddik, veihi tzedek. uvegin kach, itkerivat bahadah, uman derachik leh meatar da, rachik hu meidduna dealma deate.

Bidchura ihu tzaddik, veihi tzedek bela yod. ihu ish. veihi ishsha, bela yod. uvegin kach chedva (nusach acher teyuveta) dilah, leitkarva bah, uleitaddena bahadah. man derachik idduna da, yerachakun leh meidduna dilella. veal da ketiv, (Shmuel 1 2:30) ki mechabbeday achabbed vegomer.

Ta chaze, pinchas kaim kame dina takkifa deyitzchak, vesatim pirtza, begin kach ashlim legabbe pinchas raza deyitzchak. kam kamme pirtza dichtiv, (Tehillim 106:30) vayyaamod pinchas vayfallel. kam bepirtza kamme dina deyitzchak, begin leaggana alayyhu deyisrael. (sefer acher pinchas kaim kamme dina takkifa deyitzchak leaggana alayyhu deyisrael. dichtiv, 1 vayyaamod pinchas vayfallel. may vayyaamod, dekam bappirtza kamme dina deyitzchak, begin kach ashlim legabbe pinchas raza deyitzchak.) veal da kalil da beda bechushebana.

Vei tema, ha chushebana la talyay ella beayynin dilah, vehacha chushebana leella beyitzchak. ella vadday hachi hu, begin deyitzchak talya veishtammesha (sefer acher veitmeshach) behahu atar deinnun ayynin, detamman dayynin dinin dechol alma, deha ayynin dilah, innun shivin katedrain, atar dedinin dealma, veikrun sanhedrin. veal da kolla chad, begin deyitzchak veinnun kachada azlin, vecholla shappir.

Pinchas da yitzchak, vekam pinchas vedain dina, umitlabbash bigvura takkifa deihu semala. uvegin kach zacha limina. hacha itkelil semala bimina. heshiv et chamati, may heshiv et chamati. ella illen innun 3 memunim degehinnam: mashchit, af, vechema. (davar acher chad al shefichut damim, chad al gilluy arayot, vechad al avoda zara.) begin dechama hahu chema, dehava pashit veitmeshach missitra deyitzchak, ma avad, itlevash ihu beyitzchak, veachid behahu chema, keman
1504: Ucheden dan dina, veavid dina. dan dina, dechol boel arammit kannain pogin bo. veavid dina, dichtiv vayyidkor et shenehem. veal da ketiv hacha, heshiv et chamati. uchetiv hatam, (Eicha 2:3) heshiv achor yemino mippene oyev, ma lehallan laachora, hachi name laachora. veal da yod definchas hacha, yod deyitzchak. vecholla hu meal bene yisrael, dechad chama hahu chema, chama leh dehava nachit al reshehon deyisrael.

May chama. chama 40, at da dehava tas birkia, veda hu simana demalach hammavt, devaya leitbanaa beat vav veat 400. ma avad pinchas. dehava mitlabbash beyitzchak, keden natil hahu at 40, vechataf leh, vechibber leh bahadeh. kevan dechama malach hammavt, definchas chataf leh lehahu 40 bahadeh, miyyad tav laachora.

May tama. begin dechad kanne belibbeh pinchas, itlebash beyitzchak, veistallak lemehevi bechushebana Rosh Chodesh, vehachi salik shemeh Rosh Chodesh, vehachi salik yitzchak. kevan dechama leat 40 tas birkia, chataf leh, vechibber leh bahadeh veitavid miyyad 248, hada hu dichtiv vayyikkach romach beyado.

Begin deot 40 hava simana kadmaa leadam harishon, lemivne mavt al alma, begin deat da hava tas al resheh deadam, beshaata dichtiv, (Bereshit 3:6) vattikkach mippiryo, 40 piryo. vahava mechakka 406, bezimna dichtiv, (hakedamat Bereshit 12 amud bet) vattochal, vattitten, vattippakachna. keden itbene mavt al alma.

Pinchas hava chame leh hasheta hahu at 40, tais al reshehon deyisrael. veheach chama leh. chama diyyukena dem petucha, malya dama. kevan dechama leh, amar ha vadday simana demalach hammavt, miyyad chataf lah, adkar alah shema meforash, venachit lehay at legabbeh. uma dehava Rosh Chodesh, ittzerif 248. keden vayyikkach romach beyado. veal da ketiv meal bene yisrael bekano et kinati, dekanne lishma kaddisha, dahavo mechabberin leh birshu achara. betocham, may betocham. begin dehava azil veal bego kama uchelusin, kamma ravrevan, umasar garmeh lemota benayyhu. aval betocham, betoch 40, betoch 40 hava hahu kina dekanne.

May tama 40. begin deihi simana demavt, ihi simana dem malkiyyot. ihi simana ded mitot bet din. umittamman salik venachit, nachit vesalik, salik lem, venachit led. nachit med, innun 4 ruchin, demitparshan miggo dechar venukeba mimmesaavuta, uveginayyhu 4 mitot bet din. umittamman sallekin lem. vehayeynu 40 simana umanin demalach hammavt. veda natil pinchas, vekam betoch 40, veal da velo chilliti et bene yisrael bekinati.

Vechi haech heshiv pinchas chamateh dekudesha berich hu, vehachtiv vayyihyu hammetim bammaggefa vegomer, i la mit chad minnayyhu, hava amena heshiv et chamati, aval kevan dechol hane mitu, may tama heshiv et chamati velo chilliti et bene yisrael. ella vadday berira demilla, vavy leh lebar nash defagim zareh, vavy leh leman dela natir zareh kaddeka yaut, chas veshalom deafillu chad miyisrael mit, ella shivta deshimon, kad ate innun erev rav, itarvu benashin deshivta deshimon, batar deitgeyayru, veolidu benin, minnehon mitu baegel, uminnehon mitu bemotana, veacharanin mitu hacha, innun deishtaaru. hada hu dichtiv, vayyihyu hammetim bammaggefa, asher metu la ketiv, ella hammetim, metim demeikkara havo.

Uvegin deistamaru yisrael, vechol innun zara kaddisha, itmenun kullehu, begin dela chaser afillu chad minnayyhu. veal da ketiv, velo chilliti et bene yisrael, mikkelal deacharanin kalu. vechen heshiv et chamati meal bene yisrael, meal bene yisrael heshiv, aval meal acharanin dahavo erev rav, la heshiv. veal da rashim kera veamar, meal bene yisrael. uvegin da itmenun bene yisrael kemillekaddemin, vechibber lon kudesha berich hu bahadeh. kegavvna da beovada deegel, dichtiv, (Shemot 32:28) vayyippol min haam vegomer. chol innun meerev rav havo. uleachzaa dela havo mibbene yisrael, ma ketiv levatar, (Shemot 35:1) vayyakhel moshe et chol adat bene yisrael.

Raya mehemna, amar raya mehemana heshiv et chamati, may heshiv et chamati. ella 3 memunim degehinnam, chad al shefichut damim, vechad al giluy arayot, vechad al avoda zara. veinnun: mashchit, af, vechema. hu (chama dehava) (sefer acher chaymah dehava) tas bealma. amar heshiv et chamati meal bene yisrael, vela amar meal haam, deinnun erev rav, deittemar vayyippol min haam bayom hahu kishloshet alfe ish, dehachi okimna veshaillu levutztzina kaddisha. (ad kan)
1505: (Shemot la) kechu meittechem teruma. ta chaze, bekadmita ketiv, (Shemot 25) meet kol ish asher yiddevennu libbo. kolla bichlal. kevan deinnun erev rav avdu da, umitu minnayyhu innun demitu, baa kudesha berich hu leitpayyeysa bahadayyhu deyisrael, amar lon, itchabberu kulchu listar chad, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot la) vayyakhel moshe et chol adat bene yisrael bilchodayyhu, amar lon, banay, bechon ana bae lemishre, immechon tehe diyyura dili. veal da, (Shemot 25) kechu meittechem teruma, meittechem, vela meachara, la baena dittehe shittufa laacharanin bahadi, vela bahadayychu, uvegin kach kullehu ishtetziu. uf hacha ha innun meinnun giza bisha havo, vayyihyu hammetim. hammetim, vadday metim, vela miyisrael. uvegin kach mana lon, dichtiv seu et rosh bene yisrael, arimu reshayyhu.

Amar ribbi elazar, abba, kamma yaut hu, i la ashkachna pelugeta al da. amar leh beri emma. amar leh veha ketiv (Bamidbar 25:3) vayyitztzamed yisrael levaal peor, vetanenan deitchabbaru yisrael bahaddeh, kitzmida da deitchabbar bebar nash bekishutoy, hachi itchabbaru yisrael bevaal peor. amar leh elazar, hachi hu, vayyitztzamed yisrael levaal peor, ella ana la amarit deitdachu yisrael mehahu chova, ella deitdachu mimmota, dela sharya alayhu mota.

Amar leh veha ketiv, (Bamidbar 25:4) kach et chol rashe haam vehoka otam. amar leh rashe haam vadday, vela rashe bene yisrael. umin haam it lan lemelaf, ketiv hacha haam, uchetiv hatam (Shemot 32:1) vayyar haam. (Shemot 32:1) vayyikkahel haam. (Shemot 32:1) vayyippol min haam. aval ta chaze, vayyitztzamed yisrael levaal peor, vela palchu leh, aval min sefeh dikra ochach, dichtiv vayyochal haam veyishtachavu, vela ketiv vayyochal vayishtachu yisrael. ella haam, kevan dichtiv vayyitztzamed yisrael, may vayyochal haam. ella hahu zara bisha, havo chova deyisrael.

Uma ketiv, kechu meittechem teruma laAdonai, vela meerev rav, dela itkeriu kehilla vechibbur, ad deitavar minnehon erev rav, kivyachol bezimna demitarvin benayyhu, keillu la havo goy echad. uvegin da kechu meittechem teruma, vela mishuttafu achara, dela baena leshattefa acharanin bene uvenayychu.

Velo od, ella kad erev rav meuravin innun beyisrael, ma ketiv (Eicha 1:Adonai) hayu tzareha lerosh. veyisrael batar demitabbere minnayyhu illen ma ketiv, seu et rosh kol adat bene yisrael. vela od, ella deamar kudesha berich hu, ana bae ledayyeyra immechon. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 25:8) veasu li mikdash veshachanti betocham.

Velo od, ella kad bene yisrael begaluta, alayyhu ittemar mi meakkev seor shebbaissa, veha okmuha mare matnitin, bezimna deerev rav innun rashim al yisrael, kivyachol keillu (sefer acher avrin shuletani dekudesha berich hu), avdin shuletanu bekudesha berich hu, veyialun bemishpete kochavayya umazzale. uvegin da tzavvchin veamrin, (Yeshayahu 26:13) Adonai elohenu bealunu adonim zulatecha.

Davar acher, pinchas vechulei. kum butztzina kaddisha, veaftach mille kamme shechinta. kam butztzina kaddisha, veamar, bechibbura kadmaa ittemar hachi. ta chazi, pinchas kaim kamme dina takkifa deyitztzechak, vekam kame pirtztza, dichtiv, (Tehillim 106:30) vayyaamod pinchas vaypallel vatteatztzar hammaggefa, begin leaggana alayyhu deyisrael, uvegin da kalil da veda bechushebana, pinchas keminyan yitztzechak, vehacha tzarich lechaddeta millin.

Patach veamar, eliyyahu rechima demalka illaa, chaza mem min mavt tas baavira, chataf lah, veshattaf lah im Rosh Chodesh, deihu yitztzechak, veihu bechusheban pinchas, veishtelim bah 248. levatar chaza 6 min mavt tas birkia, vechataf leh, veshavvi leh beramach, veishtelim romach. hada hu dichtiv, vayyikkach romach beyado.

Veihu, bema yachil lachatof teren atvavn illen. bitren ruchin deishtemaru (sefer acher daatatemaren) leella, deishtetafu befinchas. pene chas. bitren panim illen, chas al yisrael dela itavidu, bechela
1506: Mahu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 25:3) vayyitztzamed yisrael levaal peor. ta chaze, vayyitztzamed yisrael bevaal peor la ketiv, ella levaal peor. kishshutin vetukepa yahavu levaal peor, bela data, begin defulechana difor hu, lemifra garmeh, uleappaka kammeh tzoa rotachat. vehahu ayvidta ahane leh, veittakaf minneh. veyisrael kevan dechamu da, chashiva dezilzula dileh ihu, vekilkula dileh, deha beavoda zara ketiv, (Yeshayahu 30:22) tze tomar lo. veinnun begin zilzula daavoda zara, paru garmayyhu bela yedia, veal hane kipper pinchas, uvittel motana, dichtiv vaychapper al bene yisrael.
