Detarvavyyhu, vayyidkor et shenehem, bitren atvavn 46. vehayeynu bekano et kinati betocham.

Vaamay ishtetaf beyitztzechak. begin deyitztzechak masar garmeh lemita. uvegin da ishtetaf leh leyitztzechak, lemehevi leh ezer. demissitra ditren izle deayyaylta, ishtattefe beh avraham veyaakov, deavraham dargeh chesed ishtetaf 70 definchas. yaakov ihu pene 31 (sefer acher yaakov ihu 140 dapenaches) definchas begin deittemar beh, (Bereshit 32:32) kaasher avar et penuyel, (sefer acher sham hammakom 140) pene el. begin dechad alma ihu bedochaka, veit tzaddik bealma mekanne al berit, avahan ishtattafu beh, uveginayyhu amar moshe bedochaka deyisrael, (Shemot 32:13) zechor leavraham leyitztzechak uleyisrael avadecha. uvitlat atvavn Yahu min eliyyahu, zacha laAdonai min hannavi, veda ihu eliyyahu, Adonai navi, (sefer acher veda raza el yehu navi) veishtelim beh Adonai.

10 Dezacha pinchas beh, begin dekanne al berit, zacha livrit. uteren yodin innun, yod illaa min Adonai, decharat bah leavraham, ben 10 etztzebaot deyadin. yod zeera ihi min adonay, decharat bah ben 10 etztzeban deraglin veihi at kaddisha, demitatra birshimu illaa.

Veda itreshim tamid lealmin, ihi ot deshabbat, ot ditfillin, ot deyomin tavin, ot deshadday derashim (Devarim 6:9) al mezuzot betecha uvisharecha. lemehevi bah reshimin yisrael birtztzuayyhu, bivrit dilhon, deinnun benoy dematronita, benoy dehechala demalka kaddisha, uveorayyta, innun reshimin beat 10 illaa, deinnun bene malka illaa, kema deukemuha. veha ittemar (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem.

Veot yod deshadday, ihu chuleya deshalshelet, al kudela deshed yitztzer hara, dela linzik leh lebar nash. dealeh amar david, (Tehillim 22:21) hatztzila mecherev nafshi miyyad kelev yechidati. ihu nachash, ihu kelev, ihu aryi. dealeh amar david, yeerov bamistar kearye vesukko. vehannavi kara leh dov, hada hu dichtiv, (Eicha 3:10) dov orev hu li ari bemmistarim. (Tehillim 49:13) nimshal kavhemot, nimshal lechol chevan misavin, deinnun dorsin, itmetil lechol bar nash, kefum chovoy, veha ittemar.

Vehay ihu kelev venachash vachamor noer, demarkivin aleh nafsha. umiyyad deishtemoda hahu derachiv aleh deihu chayyayva, aleh ketiv, (Bereshit 49:17) vayyippol rochvo achor. veraza demilla, (Devarim 22:8) ki yippol hannofel mimmennu. uvegin da amar iyyov, (Iyov 12:3) lo nofel anochi mikkem. vetztzaddik derachiv aleh, kashir leh bikshiru dirtztzuin ditfillin. ot tefillin deihu ot yod. deshadday, chuleya al kedaleh. 300 ditfillin, shalshelet al kedaleh.

Uveh rachiv eliyyahu, vesalik lishmayya. hada hu dichtiv, (Melachim 2 2:11) vayyaal eliyyahu bassoara hashshamayim. uveh (Iyov 38:1) vayyaan Adonai et iyyov min hasseara. uvegin da, okmuha rabbanan dematnita aleh, ezehu gibbor hakkovesh et yitztzero. veit leman demithaddar leh chamor, delav ihu mitztzetaer rochvo. veillen innun demishtadlin bekal vachomer. uvegin da ittemar beavraham, (Bereshit 22:3) vayyachavosh et chamoro. uvegineh ittemar al mashiach, (Zecharya 9:9) ani verochev al chamor.

Uvegin da 10 min shadday, deihu chuleyay deshalshelet, minnah (sefer acher mapechadeyn) mefuzarim kol shedin umazzikin, umiyyad dechazyayn leh bammezuzot detarin, barchin, devah ittemar, (Tehillim 149:8) lesor malchehem bezikkim venichbedehem bechavle varzel. kol shekken kad chazyayn lah beot tefillin al deroin, ureshimin bah beot berit bivsarehon, (Bamidbar 1:nusach acher) vehazzar hakkarev yumat, let zar, ella yetztzer hara, dedamya lechol chevan veofin dorsin.

Uvegin da, (Iyov 4:7) zechor na mi hu naki avad, da pinchas, dekanne al berit, veitreshim beh, deihu bera demalka umatronita. kanne bemachashava, vezache leat 10 min Adonai. vekkane beovadoy, vezacha leot 10 min adonay. vehay ihu chachma barosh. vechachma basof. uvegin deadam kadmaa hava rashum betarvavyyhu, okmuha aleh rabbanan, deihu rishon lammachashava, acharon lemaase. addehachi deamar millin illen itkasse minnayyhu. amar
1507: Ribbi elazar, (lechavroy) zakkaa chulakana, dezachena lemishma millin mibbene alma deate.

Uvechibbura kadmaa. lachen emor, beomaa alach, im hu birutach, vei lav, imma. ribbi pinchas ben yair. hahu tula batash beenoy deribbi abba, vechi la hava yada kudesha berich hu, i hava biruteh, im lav. amar leh, im leh galuy, mi galuy leacharine, uvegin da lachen emor.

Vetu ittemar bechibbura kadmaa, (Tehillim 60:1) michtam ledavid, simana deachziu leh ledavid, kad shadar leyoav laaram naharayim ulearam tzova leagacha behu kerava. amar raya mehemana, shushan edut: da sahaduta dishchinta, deihu shushan edut. deihi sahaduta dekayyeyma alan, vesahidat alan kamme malka, vedargin illain kadishin bahadah, vesiyyayta kadisha letushebachta. amar raya mehemna, shushan edut deinnun sahadin al yisrael, deinnun evarim, veihi nishmeta alayyhu. ihu siyyayta dishmayya. deittemar bah, (Melachim 1 8:32) veatta tishma hashshamayim. ihi siyyata kadishta, (umane talyay) deittemar alah tanya dimsayyea lach.

(Bamidbar 24:21) etan moshavecha vesim bassela kinnecha. etan: tanya. tamman kinna denishra illaa, veihi shechinta. vealah ittemar, (Devarim 32:11) kenesher yair kinno al gozalav yerachef, deinnun shone halachot umishnayot. vechol dibbur vedibbur denafik mippumoy dehahu tanya, deappik ben lishma didod, ben beorayyta, ben bitztzelota, ben bivracha, ben bechol pikkuda ufikkuda, ma ketiv beh. yifros kenafav, hahu nishra dehu dibbur, deveh Adonai.

Yikkachehu yissaehu al evrato, may al evrato. al hahu ever debar nash, (sefer acher al hahu nishra) deveh mitztzeva Adonai, itkere ever dishchinta. uvegin da yissaehu al evrato. yissaehu: kegon (Bamidbar 6:25) yissa Adonai panav elecha.

Umay vesim bassela kinnecha. ella amar david aleh, (Shmuel 2 22:2) Adonai sali umetztzudati. uf hachi tana, deihu beh halacha takkifa kassela, delet patish yachil lefatztzetztza yatah bechol kusheyayn dealma. behay ihu mekannena nishra, vechol tannaim itkeriu kinnim dilah. uvegin da, (Devarim 22:6) ki yikkare kan tzippor lefanecha, beorach mikre, zimna chada keushepiza veachsenay, deizdeman lefum shaata beve oshpize.

Veit deinnun bematnita dilhon dira lishchinta, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 31:16) veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat vegomer, ledorotam, ledorotam chaser, lashon dira. veit mare mishna detoratam umanutam, dela zazat shechinta minnehon kol yomehon. aval illen, ki yikkare kan tzippor lefanecha, behon shechinta beorach mikre, zimnin sharyay alayyhu veishtechachat immehon, vezimnin la ishtechachat immehon.

Veraza demilla, zimnin deishtechachat immehon, lo tikach haem. vezimnin dela ishtechachat immehon, shallech teshallach et haem. efrochim illen mare mishna. o vetztzim, mare mikra beillen dela kavin limmudayyhu, shallech teshallach et haem. aval beillen dekavin limmudayyhu, lo tikach haem al habbanim. veit mare halachot, dedamyayn lekochavayya, hada hu dichtiv, (Daniel 12:3) umatztzedike harabbim kakkochavim leolam vaed. lav kakkochavim, deittemar behon (Nechemya 9) vechol tzevaam yibbol. ella keinnun kochavayya dealma deate, deinnun leolam vaed kayyme tadir.

(Bereshit 1:26) vayyomer elohim naase adam, batar deashlimu laavidtayyhu kol uman veuman, amar lon kudesha berich hu, umanuta chada it li lemebad, diyhe shuttafa dechullana. itchabbaru kulchu kachada, lemevad beh kol echad veechad mechulaka dileh, vaana eshtetaf immechon, lemehav leh mechulaka dili. vehayeynu naase adam betztzalmenu kidmutenu. veokmuha rabbanan, delet adam ella yisrael, hada hu dichtiv, (Yechezkel 34:31) veatten tzoni tzon mariti adam attem. attem adam, vela ovde kochavim umazzalot. uvegin da (Tehillim 149:2) yismach yisrael beosav.

Amar butztzina kadisha, vadday hahu tana deittemar bessela dechivya amar da, dichtiv beh etan moshavecha vesim bassela kinnecha. ditlat avahan nikreu etanim, ureviaa etan moshavecha. deveh mityashsheva halacha, deittemar bah halacha lemoshe missinay. deihu itpeshat al shittin ribbo deyisrael, venahir lon beorayyta, keshimsha (lesihara) deitkasse belelya, venahir lechol kochavayya umazzale. velet lelya ella galuta, veihi (Yeshayahu 21:11) shomer ma millayla shomer ma millel. veitgalya bimama, deittemar (Bereshit 44:3) habboker or, boker deavraham, deittemar beh (Shemot 16:7) uvoker ureitem et kevod Adonai. (Rut 3:13) chay Adonai shichvi ad habboker.

Addehachi, ha raya mehemana nafik mehahu sela, veamar, butztzina kadisha, ma moil li leittammera mikkammach, deha la shevakna atar dela alit leittammera minach, vela ashkachna, i hachi let li leitkasyay minach.

Amar leh butztzina kadisha, batar deamar naase adam betztzalmenu kidmutenu, may nihu deamar levatar vayyivra elohim et haadam betztzalmo. amar leh, ma deokmuha al da mare matnitin, deminnehon havo amrin yibbare, uminnehon amrin la yibbare, kudesha berich hu bara leh, dichtiv vayyivra elohim et haadam betztzalmo. amar leh, i hachi
1508: Ihu, la yahiv chulaka beh chad minnayyhu, vela itavid bediyyukena dilhon, ella beikunin demalka betztzalmo kidmuto, deihu tzelem demut tavnito. amar hachi ishtemoda.

Amar chas veshalom. ella ana amena lach, deitbere becholla, veashleteh al kolla. vei hava yahiv kol chad beh chulakeh, bezimneh dehava kaseh aleh, kol chad, hava natil chulakeh minneh, (Yeshayahu 2:22) ki vamme nechshav hu.

Ella kudesha berich hu bara leh (kol chad vechad) bediukeneh, da malchut kadisha, deihi temunat kol. devah istakkal kudesha berich hu, uvara alma, vechol biryayn devara bealma, vechalal bah illain vetattain, bela piruda kelal, vechalal bah eser sefiran, vechol shemahan vechinnuyin vehavayyayn. veillat al kolla, deihu adon al kolla, velet elaha bar minneh, vela yishtechach beillain vetattain pachut minnah. begin deihi kesher dechullehu, shelimu dechullehu, lekayyeyma beh (Tehillim 103:19) umalchuto bakkol mashala. uvegin dela ishtechach illat al kolla beillain vetattain pachut minnah, afillu bechad minnayyhu, itkeriat emunat yisrael. umissitra deillat al kolla, ittemar bah, (Devarim 4:15) ki lo reitem kol temuna, aval missitra dishar biryayn. ittemar bah, (Bamidbar 12:8) utemunat Adonai yabbit.

Ata butztzina kadisha ushear chavrayyay, veishtetachu kammeh, veamru, vadday kean let man deyachil lemetal minneh chulakeh, dela yahiv beh chulaka chad bealma, ella bore almin, illat al kolla, uveh talya ansheh, o agreh, vela bemalach vesaraf, vela beshum birya dealma. uvegin da okmuha rabbanan dematnitin, hammeshattef shem shamayim vedavar acher, neekar min haolam. miyyad deshama millin illen deamar rabbi shimon butztzina kadisha chada raya mehemna. (sefer acher deamar raya mehemana butzina kaddisha chada) vechol chavrayyay barichu leh, veamru, raya mehemna, i la hava ate bar nash bealma ella lemishma da dayay.

Zakkaa ihu, man deishtedal begaluta batraa, leminda lishchinta, leokir lah bechol pikudin, ulemisbal beginah kamma dochakin. kema deittemar, agra dechalla dochaka. (Bereshit 28:11) vayyishkav bammakom hahu, im yesh 22 otiyyot deorayyta, ihi shechivat immeh.

Man yish. chachma meayin. divatar dishchinta illaa tamman, chachma tamman. uveginah ittemar, (Mishlei 8:21) lehanechil ohavay yesh. vehayeynu (Shemot 20:6) veose chesed laalafim leohavay. missitra deahavat chesed. veyesh deihi chachma limina, dehachi ukemuha harotztze lehachekim yadrim. uvegin da, lehanechil ohavay yesh.

Ta chaze berazin setimin, bemiddot dekudesha berich hu, hahi midda demishtaddelin bah, vedachrin bah, alah ittemar, bammidda sheadam moded bah moddin lo. veshivin anpin leorayyta, vehay ihu (Shemot 20:21) bechol hammakom asher azkir et shemi, tazkir et shemi mibbae leh. ella behahi midda deazkir et shemi, behahi midda avo elecha uverachticha. (ad kan 310).

(Bamidbar 26:56) al pi haggoral techalek nachalato ben rav limat. ribbi yehuda patach veamar, (Kohelet 3:14) yadati ki kol asher yaase haelohim hu yihye leolam alav en lehosif umimmennu en ligroa vegomer. shelomo malka, dechachmateh yattir al kol bene alma, la yedana ki kol asher yaase haelohim hu yihye leolam, veihu amar yadati, ma dela yada bar nash achara.

Ella vadday shelomo malka chachmateh salleka al kol bene alma, uma deihu yada la yade kol shear bene alma. ta chaze, shear umane dealma, kad ihu avid avidta, ashgach beh, veistakkal zimna uteren zimnin veavid leh, ulevatar osif aleh, o gara minneh. vekudesha berich hu lav hachi, appik avidta laammito mittohu, delet bah mammashut kelal, veihu mammash ittekkan kaddeka yaut, vela itzterich leosafa uleagrea minneh. begin kach ketiv, (Bereshit 1:31) vayyar elohim et kol asher asa vehinne tov meod.

Tu kol asher yaase haelohim, letikkuna dealma, vadday hu yihye leolam. ribbi yitzchak amar, i hachi mahu vehaelohim asa sheyyiru millefanav. ella hay kera hachi olifna, vehu raza illaa ben chavrana, hay kera hachi mibbae leh, ki kol asher asa haelohim hu yihye leolam, mahu kol asher yaase, veha ketiv ma shehaya kevar hu vaasher lihyot kevar haya, veat amrat kol asher yaase.

Ella mikra achara ishtema, ketiv (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha yaase limchakke lo. yaase, asita mibbae leh. limchakke lo, lach mibbae leh. ella atar illaa hu, denagid venafik veadlik botzinin kullehu lechol ivar, veikre olam habba. uminneh nafik chad ilana,
1509: Leitshakya uleittetakna. vehay ilana illaa veyakkira hu al kol shear ilanin, veha okmuha. vehahu olam habba denagid venafik, atkin leh lehay ilana tadir, ashke leh, umetakken leh baavidteh, meatter leh beitrin, la pasik mabbue minneh lealam lealme almin.

Behahu ilana talya mehemnuta, beh sharya mikkol shear ilanin, kiuma decholla beh. veal da ketiv, kol asher yaase haelohim hu yihye leolam. vadday hu haya hu ho vehu yehe. alav en lehosif, umimmennu en ligroa. veal da beorayyta ketiv, (Devarim 13:1) lo tosif alav velo tigra mimmennu. deilana da, deorayyta hu. vaatar da atkin haelohim tadir. haelohim setam, da gevura meen sof umeen cheker. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 40:28) en cheker litvunato, haelohim, vela elohim. veal da asa, yaase tadir, kemabbua dela paskan memoy ledare darin.

Begin kach ketiv, vehaelohim asa sheyyiru millefanav. atkin leh lehay ilana, betikkuna shelim, deachid lechol setar ella vetatta, begin deyiru millefanav. vela yachlefun leh bechillufa achara ledare darin.

Amar ribbi abba, vadday shappir ka amrat, aval tu it leistakkela, bekadmita yaase, ulevatar vehaelohim asa, ma ben hay lehay. ella (tadir) vadday yaase veatkin lehay ilana, dela paskin memoy ledare darin. ulevatar asa, mahu asa. ella asa haelohim ilana achara letatta minneh. vela yaase kehay. dehay ilana tattaa, avid leh veatkin leh, begin deman deyeul leilana illaa, yeul birshu, veyishkach leilana tataa, veyadchil lemeal, ella kedka chaze.

Ta chaze, dehay, natir pitcha hu. veal da ikre (tehillim 121) shomer yisrael veda ilana tattaa asa, itshakya umitzan meilana dilella. veal da la ketiv yaase, ella asa. may tama. sheyyiru millefanav bene alma, vela yikrevun leh, ella innun deyitchazun lekarva, vela achara, veyistamrun bene nasha arche deorayyta, vela yistun limina velismala.

Ta chaze, al hay ilana dechol cheloy beh sharya, amar david, (Tehillim 16:5) atta tomich gorali. mahu gorali. da adva deachid beh david malka. veal da, al pi haggoral (sefer acher ken beh al pi) ketiv. vechen hu al pi Adonai. vayyamat sham al pi Adonai. haggoral ketiv. zakkaa chulakehon deinnun demishtaddelin beorayyta yemama velele, veyade archoy. veinnun achle bechol yoma mezona illaa. kema deat amer, (Kohelet 7:12) hachachma techayye vealeha. deha orayyta dilella meatar da itzan, veha ittemar alayyhu, (Yeshayahu 65:13) hinne avaday yochelu.

Ribbi abba patach veamar, (Yechezkel 1:25) vayhi kol meal larakia. da kol deachid lehay rakia, veishtetaf bahadeh. veda hu (Tehillim 111:4) zecher asa lenifleotav. vehahu rekia kaim alayyhu, al innun chevavn. veda hu deivre bashsheni, (Bereshit 1:6) lehavedil ben mayim lamayim.

Veha okmuha, deshiva rekiin leella leella. vadday vilon eno meshammesh, deha let leh middileh, ella ma deyahavin leh. umiskene beh itachadu, da hu raza dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 2 22) uveanyi hachinoti levet elohay. veda machnis shacharit umotzi arvit. deha belelya, appik chayyaloy lechol sitrin, veshalta al innun chayyaylin veuchlosin. uveshacharit kanish lechullehu, veail lenukvayyhu, vela shaltin. deha boker kalil kullehu. kema deat amer (Tehillim 92:3) lehaggid babboker chasdecha veemunatcha ballelot. veha okmuha.

Vekol it al hay rakia, minneh itzan hay rakia, beshaata dehay kol itar, kullehu uchlusin la natlin, velet behu reshu, ella lemekam beduchetayyhu, veakreve chelehon umechakkan, lehahu tivu denagid lehahu rakia, veyitbarchan begineh, veal da ihu meal larakia asher al rosham.

Ta chaze umimmaal larakia asher al rosham kemare even sappir demut kisse, kemare even sappir, da even yisrael. veda hu raza dichtiv, (Bereshit 29:3) vegallu et haeven vegomer. chad even nachta milleella, kad bau yisrael lemerat ara, uchetiv beh goral. veihu amar, da liflanya, veda liflanya. veda even hu mittechot
1510: Kurseyay demalka nachta. vadday (Bereshit 49:24) mishsham roe even yisrael ketiv. uvegine kach al pi haggoral vadday techalek nachalato.

Ribbi yitzchak veribbi yehuda havo azle meusha lelud, paga behu ribbi elazar, rahatu abbatreh. amru, vadday narhit abbatreh dishchinta. ad dematu legabbeh, amru vadday nishtattef bahadach, venishma milla chadta.

Patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 51:1) shimu elay rodfe tzedek mevakshe vegomer. shimu elay rodfe tzedek, innun deazlin batar mehemnuta, rodfe tzedek, vadday innun mevakshe Adonai. i baitu leminda mehemnuta, uleachada lehay tzedek, la tistakkelun bah bilchodaha kishar bene alma, degarmu mita legarmayyhu al da. aval (Yeshayahu 51:1) habbitu el tzur chutztzavtem veel makevet bor nukkartem. <small></small>

(Bamidbar 28:2) tzav et bene yisrael veamarta alehem et karbani lachmi vegomer. ketiv (Shmuel 1 15:22) hachefetz laAdonai beolot uzevachim kishmoa bekol Adonai vegomer. let reuta dekudesha berich hu, deyechuv bar nash, veal choveh yakriv karban. ella karban deihu beli chova, da ihu karban shelim, veikre shelamim, vekarban tamid uf hachi, veaf al gav dimchapper al chovin.

Ribbi abba patach, (Tehillim 51:19) zivche elohim ruach nishbara vegomer. hay kera okmuha, diruta dekudesha berich hu, la itree bekarban debar nash al chovoy, ella ruach nishbara. uvene nasha la yade may kaamre, vehachi shemana mibbutzina kadisha, dechad ate bar nash leistaava bechovoy, amshich aleh ruach, missitra demisava, veitgae al bar nash, veshalit aleh lechol reuta. vehahu sitra misava, itgabbar becheleh veittakaf, veshalit aleh liruteh. ate bar nash veshalit aleh leitdakkea, medakkein leh.

Bezimna dehava be makdesha kayyaym, akriv karbaneh, kol kappara dileh talyay aleh, ad deitcharat, vetavar lehahu ruach miggo gauta dileh, umaich leh. veda hu teviru, dehahu darga demisava. vechad itbar hahu ruach misava, vekariv karbaneh, da ihu deitkabbel beraava kaddeka yaut.

Vei la itbar hahu ruach, lav karbaneh kelum, ulechalbe itmesar, deha karbena da lav dekudesha berich hu, ella michalbe. uvegin kach zivche elohim kaddeka yaut, hu ruach nishbara, deyitbar hahu rucha misava, vela yishlot. veal da man deyitbar leh kaddeka yaut, aleh ketiv, (Tehillim 78:39) ruach holech velo yashuv. lihevi hahu gavra beavtachuta, dela yetuv legabbeh lealmin. hada hu dichtiv, velo yashuv. lev nishbar venidke, hahu gavra dela itgae, vela itanneg beinnugin dealma, elohim lo tivze, bikara ihu legabbeh.
(Bamidbar 28) tzav et bene yisrael. may tzav. da avoda zara. begin dela yeul garmeh leistaava beruach misava, deihu avoda zara mammash.

Ribbi elazar patach. (Shir HaShirim Adonai:1) bati leganni achoti challa vegomer. hay kera okmuha, aval it setarim bekarbana (sefer acher shit sidrin dekarbena) hacha, vecholla ittemar. amar leh rabbi shimon, yaut hu, desharit milla, vesatamt, ema. (sefer acher nasetamet amay) amar, begin dachamena besifra dechanoch milla, veolifna. amar, ema hahi milla dechamit
1511: Amar kolla chad milla, kudesha berich hu amar da, bati leganni, begin dechol karbenin dealma kad sallekin, kullehu ayylin lego ginta deeden bekadmita, raza dekneset yisrael. veheach bekadmita veshiruta dekarvena, beshaata debar nash ode chetoy alah, unechisu uzeriku dedameh al madbecha.

Hasheta it leistakkela, heach innun ruchin kadishin ithanun mehay. umay tama dekarbena divhema, veha yatir hava sagya, letavra bar nash hahu rucha, uleatava betiyyuveta may tama nechisu divhema, uleokda leh benura demadbecha.

Ella raza hu, begin deit behema dirvia al elef turin, veelef turin achlat bechol yoma, vechullehu ikrun (Tehillim 50:10) behemot beharere alef. veal da tanenan, deit beira achil beire. umimma havo. meeshsha. vechullehu lachich lon hahi behema bilchicha chada, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 4:24) ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu el kanna. vechol mayya deyarden, deamla beshit shenin, hi avdat leh gemia chada, hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 40:23) yivtach ki yagiach yarden el pihu.

Sitra demilla, chamira dechol hane, ikkara visoda lehane beire diltatta. begin derucha minnayyhu mitfashsheta (sefer acher deruche divire minnayyhu atepashetav) letatta, veittzayayr hahu rucha letatta bivire. vechad chav bar nash, ayyte beira lekarbena, vehahu rucha divira da, salleka vetav leatreh, umitpashshat hahu rucha bechullehu. vechol innun dezina da, mitkarvin veatyayn veithanyayn mehahu chelba vedama, dehahu levusha derucha da, deha missitra dilhon hava (begin) hahu rucha (dilhon). vechulhon ithanu veittezanu, veitabbedun sannegorin al hahu bar nash. veal derech veshet, kema deittemar. uvegin kach karbena min habbehema.

Amar rabbi shimon, berich beri lekudesha berich hu, alach ittemar (Mishlei 23:25) yismach avicha veimmecha vetagel yoladtecha. yismach avicha, dilella. veimmecha, da keneset yisrael. vetagel yoladtecha, da berateh deribbi pinchas ben yair chasida. elazar beri ema, ha kurebana divhema, karbena deofe may. dichtiv, (Vayikra 1:14) veim min haof ola karbano. amar leh, la chamena, aval istakkalna mehay milla divhema, milla deofe. vela ema, begin dela chamena, vead kean la shemana.

Amar leh elazar, yaut amart. aval raza dekarbenin sitrin saggiin tamman, vela itmesaru legallaa, bar lezakkae keshot, deraza demarehon la itkasse minnayyhu. sitra dekarbenin, da ihu sitra, leinnun manin (sefer acher chevan) kaddishin. 4 diukenin chakukin bechisse, veda ihu kuresyay upparnasa demalka kaddisha. pene shor. pene nesher. pene arye. pene adam. pene adam dechalil lechullehu. vechol anpin mistakkelin illen leillen, veitkelilan illen beillen, uminnayyhu mitpashshetan lechamma sitrin verivvavn, ella vetatta, delet lon shiura uminyayna vecheshbon.

Pene shor, itpeshat livire rucha minneh, learbea zayynin, veitkelilan bechad, veillen innun: parim, uchevasim, veattudim, veizzim. veillen kayymin lekarbena. uvegin deminnehon havo, innun chayyaylin kaddishin demitpashshete mehahu pene shor, mitkarvin lisoda dilhon, veithanun mehahu yesoda ulevusha dilhon. vei la dahavu lehu yesoda dehay alma, la mitkarvin tamman.

Kegavvna dahavi nayycha lishchinta kaddisha, meruchehon detzaddikayyay, veitkerivat lekabbela rucha dehahu zakkaa, veithanaat minneh, begin deminnah hava hahu ruach. kach illen ithanun missitra diysoda dilhon, veithanun mehahu levusha demitkarve leh, (sefer acher deha) ruach malbusha (sefer acher kach illen matehanevan mehahu levusha dametakerabev missitra diysoda dilhon, deha chalava vedama levusha) derucha dilhon hava. uvegin kach ithanun minnayyhu.

Pene nesher itpeshat leofa ruach minneh. venesher bitren sitrin ihu. veraza da (Bereshit 1:20) veof yeofef, teren ruchin. uvegin kach itpeshat venachta (sefer acher venashar bitren sitrin ihu. yemina usemala veraza da 1 vaof yeofef, uvegin kach teren ruchi matepashetav minneh unechatu) mimina umissemala karbena deofe.
Mikkol setar dachya, la itkeriv ella yona vetorim, deinnun bikshot leziuugayyhu,
1512: Mikkol shear ofin. vehem nirdafin, velo rodfin. umehemana da leda, nukeva levar zugo. veal da karbena minnayyhu. venachte umitkarve innun ruchin kaddishin, veithanyayn miyyesoda veikkara dilhon.

Vei tema, hech itpeshat zeer mehay yona, o mishshafnina da, lechamma sitrin chayyaylin delet lon shiura. o min beira chada uf hachi. ta chaze. chad sheraga dakik dalik, itmalleyay minneh kol alma. tu aa dakik, adlik leravreva.

Ad hacha karbena mitteren sitrin dechakikin bechisse. hasheta it lemishal, 4 diukenin innun, dechakukin bechisse, may tama let karbenin meacharanin. ella vday mikkullehu it karbena. arye chakuk bechuresyay, beshaata dekarbena shelim, arye nachit veal beeshsha, veachil veitnahe mittamman. adam chakuk bechuresyay, adam ikkara decholla, umakriv tamman rucheh venishmateh, veadam illaa ithane meadam tattaa, vechol zina itkeriv lezineh, veithane minneh midileh mammash, umisoda dileh.

Vei tema, ha arye delet leh yesoda letatta behahu karbena. arye kalil bechullehu, deha limina havi, uvegin kach achil bechullehu, vechol shear la achlin (sefer acher minneh) mizzineh, begin dimina hu. ha kol 4 diukenin dechakukin bakkisse, mitkarvin lekarbena, uvegin kach havi karbena shelim. vechad ithanun meikkara visoda dilhon, keden nachat ruach leadleka butzinin ilain.

Kahane velevae veyisraele, yahave (sefer acher inun) yesoda veikkara leinnun dargin illain dilhon. vechol darga yahiv lisodeh 4 diukenin dechuresyay bekadmita. kidamaran zina lokovel zineh, umitkarve innun bekadmita zina lezineh. pene shor kullehu panim demitpashtan leinnun zinin kidkaamran, kullehu mitkarve leikara visoda dilhon. pene nesher, kidamaran. pene arye, kidamaran. pene adam, demakriv rucheh venishmateh mitkeriv legabbe adam illaa.

Kahana dimyached shema kaddisha, mitkarev legabbe kahana illaa. hahu deal levet kodesh hakkodashim. veitkeriv da, veadlik betikkuneh binhiru deanpin (sefer acher deatvavn), lekadmut kahana diltatta. levae di menaggene bechedva, hahu sitra dilhon chadde, veanhir anpin. yisrael dekariv, (sefer acher dekayymu) al karbena bitzlota, deha tzelota al kolla hava. ittear legabbayyhu yisrael sava (sefer acher ilaa), setama (sefer acher chotama) kaddisha, veanhir anpin.

Kol zina lezineh, vechol milla batar yesoda dileh azla veattearu dargin tattain ledargin illain, veaf al gav dechullehu mitarin, veattearu dargin dechakikin bakkisse, legabbe dargin deara, yesoda dilhon. veinnun dargin illain demittammeran, kullehu mitare umitkarve lisudata, umitaddene. aval let reshu lechad minnayyhu lemechal, la ledarge illae, vela ledarge tattae, ulemithane shum hanaa, vela leoshit yeda bekarbana, ad demalka illaa achil veithane, veyahiv lon reshu.

Levatar deyahav lon reshu, kol chad vechad ithane veachil (kedka yeot). vehayeynu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:1) ariti mori im besami, illen innun dargin illain. mori im besami, achle veithane kaddeka yaut. (sefer acher da deroa yemina, beyarcha semala). achalti yari im divshi, da yaakov berachel, da achila kaddeka yaut. shatiti yeni im chalavi, da deroa semala, beyarcha yemina. ha kullehu dargin (sefer acher karbenin) illain, deithane behu malka kaddisha bekadmita. veda mechla dileh vahanaa dileh. ad hacha mechla demalka illaa bekadmita.

Mikkan ulehala, yahiv reshu led diukenin dechakikin bechuresyay, ulechol innun demitpashshetan minnayyhu, leithane ulemechal. hada hu dichtiv, ichlu reim shetu veshichru dodim. ichlu reim, illen innun arba diukenin deamaran. shetu veshichru dodim, kol innun demitpashshete minnayyhu, vechullehu achle umitpashshete, veithanun kaddeka yaut, veanhiru anpin, vealmin kullehu bechedva,
1513: Vechol chad vechad, ben dargin illain, uven dargin tattain, bisoda dilhon mitkarvin umithanin. da ihu raza vesitra dekarbena kaddeka chaze.

Atu ribbi elazar vribbi abba ushear chavrayyay, veishtetachu kammeh. amar ribbi abba, ilmale la itmesar orayyta betura desinay, ella deamar kudesha berich hu, ha bar yochay orayyta vesitrin dili, daye lealma. vavy kad tistallak min alma. man yanhir butzinin deorayyta, kolla yitchashach mehahu yoma. deha ad deyete malka meshicha, la liheve dara kedara da, derabbi shimon shari begavvih.

Amar rabbi shimon, al raza da, asir leh lebar nash litom kelum, ad deyechul malka illaa, uma ihu. tzelota. tzelota debar nash, kegavvna da, bekadmita, mezamnin lediyyukenin dechakikin bechuresyay, al innun biryayn, demitpashshete ruchin dilhon, al ofe uveire, lekarbena biryayn derucha dilhon yesoda behay alma minnayyhu, vehayeynu (Tehillim 104:24) ma rabbu maasecha Adonai, deha biryayn deitchazyayn lekarbena rucha dilhon, mitpeshshat alayyhu arba diukenin, mezammenan al karbenin illen. vehayeynu dekaamaran, vehaofannim vechayyot hakkodesh, vechol innun chayyaylin acharanin deka mitpashshete minnayyhu.

Ulevatar kahana rabba deka meyayched shema kaddisha, hayeynu ahavat olam ahavtanu vechulei. yichuda deka meyayched, hayeynu (Devarim 6:4-Adonai) shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad. ulevatar levae, deka mitare lenigguna, hayeynu (Devarim 11:16) vehaya im shamoa vegomer, hishshamru lachem pen yifte vegomer. da nigguna delevae, begin leastara sitra (sefer acher leitteara sitra) da, bekorbana da. ulevatar yisrael, da emet veyatztziv venachon, yisrael sava dekayyeyma al karbena, (karbena ilaa ha dargin) deihi 10 dargin illain penimain decholla, kayyeyma al patora.

Aval let reshu lechad minnayyhu lemechal, uleoshit yeda lekarbena, ad demalka illaa achil. vehayeynu 3 rishonot, veg acharonot. kevan deihu achil, yahiv reshu led diukenin, ulechol innun sitrin demitparshan minnayyhu, lemechal.

Keden adam, deihu diyyukena dechalil kol shear diukenin, maich venafil al anpoy, umasir garmeh verucheh legabbe adam dilella, dekayyeyma al innun diukenin, dechalil kol diukenin, leatteara leh aleh kaddeka chaze, vehayeynu (Tehillim 25:1) elecha Adonai nafshi essa, leatteara (telat) diukenin acharanin, vechol innun demitpashshete minnayyhu. (tehilla ledavid) vehayeynu (Tehillim 145:11) yabbiu. yerannenu. yomeru. yedabberu. vechullehu achlin veithanyayn kol chad vechad kaddeka chaze leh.

Mikkan ulehala lema bar nash aku dileh beh (sefer acher delibbeh), hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 20:2) yaancha Adonai beyom tzara. (aku) keubbarta deyatva beaku, leithappecha kullehon sannegorin aleh debar nash. veal da ketiv (Tehillim 144:15) ashre haam shekkacha lo vegomer.

Rabbi shimon hava azil litverya, paga beh eliyyahu, amar leh shelama aleh demor. amar leh rabbi shimon, bemay ka asik kudesha berich hu birkia. amar leh bekarbanot asik, veamar millin chadattin mishshemach, zakkaa ant, vaatena leakdema lecha shelam, umilla chada baena lemishal minach, leaskema. bimtivta dirkia sheelta shailu, alma deate let beh achila ushetiyya, veha ketiv (Shir HaShirim Adonai:1) bati leganni achoti challa vegomer, achalti yari im divshi vegomer. man delet beh achila ushetiyya, ihu amar achalti yari im divshi shatiti yeni im chalavi.

Amar rabbi shimon, vekudesha berich hu may ka ativ lon. amar leh, amar kudesha berich hu, ha bar yochay yemma. vaatena lemishal minach. amar rabbi shimon, kama chavivu chibbev kudesha berich hu lichneset yisrael, umissegiu dirchimu derachim lah, shane ovadoy mimma dehu avid. deaf al gav delav orchoy bemechla umishteyyay, begin rechimuta, achil veshata. hoil veate legabbah, avid reutah. kalla ayylat lachuppa, uvaat lemechal, let din deyechul chatanah bahadah, af al gav delav archeh lemebad hachi. hada hu dichtiv bati leganni achoti challa. hoil vaatena legabbah, ulemeal bahadah lachuppa,
1514: Veyalfenan middavid, dezammin lekudesha berich hu, veshanne ovadoy mimma dearchoy dekudesha berich hu, vekudesha berich hu kabbil veavid reuteh. zammin lemalka umatronita bahadeh, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 132:8) kuma Adonai limnuchatecha atta vaaron uzzecha. malka umatronita kachada, begin dela leafresha lon, shanne manin, veshanne ovadin demalka.

Hada hu dichtiv, (tehillim lev) kohanecha yilbeshu tzedek vachasidecha yerannenu baavur david vegomer, kohanecha yilbeshu tzedek, leviyyecha mibbae leh, deha tzedek missitra delevae ihu. vachasidecha yerannenu, leviyyecha yerannenu mibbae leh, deha rinna vezimra belevae ninhu, veihu shanne veamar, kohanecha vachasidecha, deinnun missitra dimina.

Amar leh kudesha berich hu, david lav orach dili hachi. amar david, baavur david avdecha al tashev pene meshichecha. tikkuna daana takkinat, la teshane leh. amar leh, david, hoil vezaminat li, it li lemebad reutach, velav reuti. veyalfenan mehay, orcha dealma, deman dimzammen leachara, hahu deate legabbeh, it leh lemebad reuteh, af al gav delav orcheh bechach.

Kach (Bereshit 28:11) vayyikkach meavne hammakom vegomer, hoil veata chatan legabbe kalla, af al gav delav orcheh lemishkav. ella becharim uchesatot, veihi yahavah leh avanin lemishkav, kolla yekabbel biruta delibba. hada hu dichtiv, vayyishkav bammakom hahu, al innun avanin, af al gav delav orcheh bechach.

Uf name hacha, achalti yari im divshi af al gav delav archoy bechach, begin rechimu dechalla. veim kol da beveta dechalla vela baatar achara. beatreh la achil vela shate, baatar dilah achil veshate. hada hu dichtiv, bati leganni. malachin deshadar kudesha berich hu leavraham, la achlu vela shatu beatrayyhu, begin avraham achlu veshatu. amar leh, ribbi. chayyecha, milla da bae kudesha berich hu lememar, uvegin dela lemechzak tivu legarmeh, kamme keneset yisrael, salik milla legarmach, zakkaa ant bealma, demarach mishtebach bach leella. vealach ketiv, (Shmuel 2 23:3) tzaddik moshel yirat elohim.

(Bamidbar 28:2) et karbani lachmi leishshay vegomer, ribbi yudai amar, bekarbana it ashan, veit reach, veit nichoach. ashan: innun mare derugeza. dichtiv, (Devarim 29:19) ki az yeshan af Adonai. innun ithanun meashan. veashan rugeza, bechotama ihu. reach: innun deikrun tappuchin. amar ribbi abba, kattappuchim. hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 7:9) vereach appech kattappuchim.

(Bamidbar 28:4) et hakkeves echad taase vabboker. may vabboker. da boker deavraham. dichtiv, (Bereshit 22:3) vayyashkem avraham babboker. menalan dehay boker deavraham hu. amar ribbi elazar, mehacha, (Bereshit 44:3) habboker or. boker or la ketiv, ella habboker or, veda or kadmaa, devara kudesha berich hu beovada divreshit, veal da taase vabboker, vabboker deishtemodaa. velokovel boker deavraham, itkeriv karbena da. karban deven haarbayim, da yitzchak, velokovel erev deyitzchak itkeriv. menalan. dichtiv, (Bereshit 24:63) vayyetze yitzchak lasuach bassade lifnot arev. veerev deyitzchak hu, veha okimna.

Raya mehemna pikkuda da lehakeriv mincha bechol yom, ulehakriv karban musaf shabbat. vaabbatreh lehasedir lechem happanim ulevona. vekarban musaf berosh chodesh. butzina kaddisha, bechol yoma tzarich leshaddure dorona lemalka bida dematronita. i ihi birshu balah, tzarich tosefet, kegon musaf beshabbat uverosh chodesh, umusaf dechol yomin tavin.

Deihi reshut hayyachid dileh veammuda deemtzaita ihu balah dehay reshut. veyaakov detikken tzelota dearvit, ihu darga dileh deammuda deemtzaita. begin da okmuha mare matnitin, tefillat arvit reshut, deaf al gav divgaluta dedome lelayla, deshaltin tamman samael venachash, vechol memanan deuchlusin dileh, ushechinta nachtat begaluta im yisrael, ihi birshu devalah ishtakkechat, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 42:8) ani Adonai hu shemi uchevodi leacher lo etten.
Uvegin da (Bereshit 28) vayyifga bammakom, let pegia, ella piusa. kegon (Rut 1) al tifgei vi. keneset yisrael payysat leh, dela yazuz minnah, dekudesha berich hu ihu mekomo shel olam. may olam. da
1515: Shechinta. targum olam, alma, lishana deulema, kema deat amer, haalma. uma ketiv beh, (Bereshit 28) vayyalen sham, itpeyays immah, lemevat tamman begaluta im shechinta. vei tema deyaakov payis lah, shappir. uvegin deihi bechol lelya, deihu galuta, birshu balah, okmuha tefillat arvit reshut. ufirusha acharina, ihu teven lemechal liviran chomriyyim bekal vachomer. nachtu mare matnitin, veishtetachu kammeh, vechadde behay milla, vekashru lah bechamma kishrin derazin setimin. veatteru lah, useliku lah legabbe chavrayyay deishtaaru tamman.

Amar raya mehemana, butzina kaddisha, begin da bishar tzelotin ihu chova, dishtar chov alayyhu, lesamcha lah betzaddik chay almin, deveh kol hassomech geula lattefilla, eno nizok bechol oto yom. uvemay semichat al yesod. bidroa yemina. hada hu dichtiv, (Rut 3:13) chay Adonai shichvi ad habboker.

Kad mate zeman tzelota demincha, baerev hi vaa. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 8:11) vattavo elav hayyona leet erev. begin demincha shelucha hi laadoni, (adonay mibbae leh) begaluta deesav, (sham 32) vehinne gam hu acharenu. veod laadoni (adoni laadoni), da ihu adon kol haaretz, veda tzaddik, mittamman yosef hatztzadik, (Devarim 33:17) bechor shoro haddar lo. deatid lenafka minneh mashiach ben efrayim. uvegineh ittemar (Bereshit 37:7) vehinne kama alummati vegam nitztzava vehinne tesubbena alummotechem vattishtachavyna laalummati. uvatztzaddik, kol hakkorea korea bevaruch.

Amar butzina kaddisha, raya mehemana, bach ittemar (Shemot 13:19) vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef. begin deguf uverit chashvenan chad. uvegin da alach ittemar, vehinne kama alummati vegam nitztzava. dechach tefilla meumad. vechen kol hazzokef zokef beshem. uvatztzaddik, kol hakkorea korea bevaruch, vehayeynu vattishtachavyna laalummati. deant achid bimina uvismala, beguf uverit. ulevatar tistallak alayyhu labbina, lemiftach bah chamshin tarin decheru leyisrael. lekayyeyma, (Micha 7:15) kime tzetcha meeretz mitzrayim arennu niflaot, uvegin da tzelota deshacharit chova, dearvit reshut.

Bearvit ihu hashekivenu, dishchivat ben deroe malka begaluta. kad yete tzafra, pesach achid beh bimina. aval bidroa semala deyitzchak, tishre. (Bereshit 24:15) vayhi hu terem killa ledabber vehinne rivka yotzet, min galuta. uvegin dela nafke missitra dedina, yaakov (Bereshit 48:14) sikkel et yadav, veshavvi shor bimina, arye bismala. uvegin da (Tehillim 110:1) neum Adonai ladoni shev limini, da tzaddik, lokovleh mashiach ben yosef, veamar leh shev limini, deroa deavraham, begaluta deyishmael, ad ashit oyvecha hadom leraglecha.

Behahu zimna, yittear ruach yetera tosefet al yisrael, hada hu dichtiv, (Yoel 3:1) eshpoch et ruchi al kol basar, veyehevi nayycha leyisrael meumin dealma, (Ester 9:16) venoach meoyvehem. kegavvna deshabbat, deittosaf bebar nash nefesh yetera beshabbat, veit lon bah nayycha, i benefesh yetera it lon nayycha, deihi nukeba, kol shekken berucha deihu dechura.

Vetanaim vaamoraim, nefesh yetera beshabbat lechol yisrael kachada, chad ihi. aval lechol bar nash, ihu kefum ovadoy. veolifna mikal vachomer detiuveta, dechol yisrael kachada, bechol zimna dechazrin kullehu, mitkabbele. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 4:7) kaAdonai elohenu bechol karenu elav, deshem Adonai muchetar alayyhu bechitreh, deihu keter elyon. vehay ihu neshama yetera dechol yisrael, beshabbat veyomin tavin. uvegin da takkinu bechol yomin, lemichtam beshem yedod, deihu chotam dechol birchan ditzlotin, vela amrin musaf bela keter. uveshabbat, takkinu lememar bemusaf, keter yittenu lecha Adonai elohenu.

Aval lechol chad miyisrael, hachi nachit leh nefesh yetera, kefum darga dileh. i hu chasid, yahavin leh nefesh yetera mimmiddat chesed, kefum darga dileh. i ihu gibbor, yere chet, yahavin leh nefesh yetera, mimmiddat gevura. vei ihu ish tam, yahavin leh nefesh yetera, mimmiddat emet. venefesh yetera da malchut, deihi kelila meeser sefiran, uchefum midda debar nash. im nasi yisrael, o chacham, o mevin bechachma, o battora, deittemar beh, (Mishlei 1:6) lehavin mashal umelitza. o banneviim, o bakketuvim. hachi yahavin leh nefesh yetera, deitkeriat keter malchut.

Vei chacham, kema deokimna hammachkim lechol adam, deittemar (Tehillim 104:24) kullam bechachma asita, yahavin leh nefesh yetera mittamman. veim hu mevin davar mittoch davar beorayyta, yahavin leh nefesh yetera mibbina. veim hu chacham banviim uvakketuvim, yahavin leh nefesh yetera minnetzach vehod. vei ihu tzaddik gamur denatar ot berit, ot shabbat, ot yomin tavin, ot tefillin, yahavin leh nefesh yetera mitztzaddik, uvechol atar, nefesh yetera mimmalchut.
Vei ihu bar nash mikkol middot illen, yahavin leh keter beshem yedod, kaydod
1516: Elohenu bechol karenu elav. en kadosh kaydod. mealma didchura, deihu tiferet, melech muchetar becheter illaa, devah yimloch bishchinteh, deihi nefesh yetera. vecheter neshama yetera, Adonai, ruach, deittemar (Yoel 3:1) eshpoch et ruchi al kol basar, veihu kalil 10 sefiran meella letatta, kegavvna da: 10 chachma. Adonai bina. 6 kalil shit sefiran, mechesed ad yesod. Adonai malchut. 20 min kaydod elohenu, keter al resheh. vehay ihu neshama deittosfa beyom shabbat.

Uvegin deillat haillot, mufele umechusse behay keter, veitpashshat beshem Adonai beshabbatot veyamim tovim, let shuletanuta lesamael ulenachash ulechol memanan dileh, velet leh shultanuta laggehinam, nukeba bisha desamael, vela lemashiryayn dileh, kullehu mittammerin min kodam mashshiryayta demalka, kegavvna deyittammeran umin ovde kochavim umazzalot dealma, kad yitgele meshicha, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 2:19) uvau bimarot tzurim (Yeshayahu 7:19) uvinkike hasselaim.

Kamu tanain vaamorain, veamru, raya mehemana, ant hu shakil lechol yisrael, memule mikkol middot tavin, vadday bach sharyay, hahu deittemar beh, (Shmuel 1 2) en kadosh kaydod elohenu. ant keter al kol chad vechad miyisrael, ki en biltecha bar nash, diyhe keter alach, la nasi, vela chacham, vela mevin, vela chasid, vela gibbor, vela tam, vela navi, vela tzaddik, vela melech. ant hu bediyyukena dekudesha berich hu, bera bediyyukena daavuhi, kegavvna deyisrael, deittemar behon, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem. ashlim pikudin demarach, delet pikudin meillen dilach, dela yitatter beh kudesha berich hu ushechinteh ella vetatta, becheter illaa, bechol midda umidda.

Patach veamar, tanain vaamorain, dechad hava kare lechullehu, lerabbi shimon bichlal immehon bechol zimna, amor lon, ana meshabbachna lechu, kefum nedivut dilchon, deattun bene nedivim avraham yitzchak veyaakov. let man deyachil leshabbecha lechon, ella mare alma, deafillu orayyta kullah ad en sof, bechu hi talya. kegavvna deittemar beorayyta, (Iyov 11:9) arukka meeretz midda urechava minni yam, hachi shevach dilchu. aval yitkayyem bechu, ma deitkayyaym bi, dachadena bikara deaharon achi, kema deokmuha, hallev shesamach bigdulat achiv, yilbash urim vetumim.

Vetanain vaamorain, kol musafin deshabbatot veyamim tovim, kol musaf deamrinan beh keter, mehacha ishtemodin. vechol tzelotin deyisrael, recha dilhon, kerecha (Shir HaShirim 3:6) demor ulevona vechol avkat rochel, bishar yomin. aval beshabbatot veyamim tovim, chashiv aleh mikkol mine besamim.

Begin divyomin tavin, sallekin mikkol avkat rochel, deittemar beh, (Bereshit 32:25) vayyeavek ish immo. ditzlota deihi pegima, itavak immah samael, leaggacha imme behahu pegimu daavera, behahu avak deda, veda salik ad shemaya.

Avak deyaakov, leolfa zechuta al tzelota, bechamma mashshiryayn dechovin (davar acher dazekavevan) deinnun (sefer acher chelin) chavilin umashiryayn, demitkanneshin immeh, leolfa zechu alah. veavak darga desamael, salik bechamma mashiryayn dechovin, leolfa chovin alah, veda tzelota dearvit, deikre sullam deyaakov, devah (Bereshit 28:12) vehinne malache elohim olim veyordim bo. illen desallekin chovin, venachte zachvavn techotayyhu, veillen sallekin zachvavn, venachtin chovin techotayyhu. umashpilin lon bechamma keravin.

Deinnun mare terisin, bemilchamtah shel tora, ad deyishtema kerava leturin ravrevin, deinnun avraham yitzchak veyaakov, hada hu dichtiv, (Micha 6:2) shimu harim et riv Adonai. riv ditzlota. riv deorayyta. vehay kerava ditzlota dearvit, ad alot hashachar. derabban gamliel okmah, ad alot hashshachar. ditfillat arvit zemanah kol hallayla, ella dechachamim avdu gader ad chatzot.

Uvegin da vayyeavek ish immo ad alot hashshachar, man shachar. tzelota dearvit. deshiurah ad boker deavraham, deihi arba shaot (Bereshit 22:3) vayyashkem avraham babboker. beresh shaata kadmaa, besof hashshachar, (deihu) netzach yaakov, detamman (Tehillim 22:1) lamnatztzeach al ayyelet hashshachar, lenatla nukema misamael, denaga beyarech semala deyaakov, deihu hod, deveh ittemar (Eicha 1:13) netanani shomema kol hayyom dava, hod, missitra dehod, elef chamishshaa, ishtearat be makdesha chareva vivesha.

Amar rabbi shimon, da hod dilach raya mehemana, deveh ant charev, minnevua dilach missemala, uvegin deant (Yeshayahu 63:12) molich limin moshe deihu netzach, resha deshachrin, (Mishlei Adonai:19) ayyelet ahavim, patach david lamnatztzeach al ayyelet hashshachar, deveh yete mare natzchan keravayyay. uvegin denetzach vehod teren shachrin, ukemuha bematnitin meematay korin et shema beshachrin, vela amar bashshachar. ella beshachrin teren.
Uteren meshichin yittearun legabbayyhu, mashiach ben david, lokovel netzach, veitkeshar babboker deavraham, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 16:11) neimot
1517: Bimincha netzach. hod bigvura, deveh mashiach ben efrayim achid. ant beemtzaita, dedarga dilach tiferet, deitkeshar bach ammuda deemtzaita. visod chay almin bedarga dilach. vechachma bayyamin, harotze lehachekim yadrim. uvina lismala, harotze lehaashir yatzpin.

Ihi hakkeshet gabbach, vehay ihu levusha dishchinta. levusha detzaddik, deitkere berit hakkeshet. veihu ot shabbat, veot yom tov, veot tefillin, veot berit mila. veamar kudesha berich hu, man delav ihu rashim behay ot, la yeul bemara da, becheder da. vehay ihu matte, deammuda deemtzaita matte beh kelappe chesed latzaddikim gemurim, lemehav lon zachvavn, bechy birchan ditzlota. umatte kelappe chova lerashiayyay, lemedan lon bigvura ledina, kefum ovadehon. uveamuda deemtzaita maarich al benoniyyim. vehay ihu 300.

Telat gavvnin dekeshet, ot berit hakkeshet, bat yechida, shabbat malketa. veit lah shit dargin, techot shuletanuta, deinnun sheshet yeme hammaase, dichlilan bimtatron. dealayyhu ittemar, (Shemot 23:12) sheshet yamim taase maasecha. aval bat yechida, shabbat laydod, haose bah melacha yumat.

Adonai itkere beot Adonai. umissitra da, 20 limina. deihu Adonai shelimu dileh. vehachi lechol sitra beshit sitrin, yado, devay, veyad, yod, dayyo, vedi. innun 18 atvavn, dichlilan betzaddik chay almin. veihi reviit hahin bechol sitra.

Veihi hei, missitra dishma meforash, yod hei vav. yod bechesed, hei bigvura, vav betiferet. kad shalta hay 39, asru chachamim arbaim melachot chaser achat. veitkeriu avot melachot, al shem deinnun lokovel avahan, deshalit alayyhu 39, deihu arbaim chaser achat.

Uveillen arbaim melachot chaser chad, laka asara malkiot laadam. vaasara lechavva. vaasara lannachash. vetisha leara. uvegin detl shalta beshabbat deihu Adonai, en lokin beshabbat. vehay 39 lav ihu ketl dechol, missitra deeved metatron. vearbaim melachot chaser achat, hem hazzorea vehachoresh vechulei.

Sava sava, shechinta itkere eretz dekudesha berich hu. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 66:1) vehaaretz hadom raglay. missitra dechesed itkeriat mayim. umissitra digvura itkeriat esh. umissitra deammuda deemtzaita avvir. veihi eretz, karka lechullehu.

Uvegin denishmeta yetera itpashsheta bishchinta, deihi shabbat malketa, deittemar bah (Tehillim 103:19) umalchuto bakkol mashala, mishsham ihi malchut, deshaltanutaha al ara, veal ilanin uzerain. (vatevareyn vaavanin) uvegin deilana dechayye, dehi nishmeta yetera divshabbat, bah toladin dilah, it nayycha leara, deihi shechinta.

Uvegin dishchinta illaa itpashshetat beara, deittemar bah (Bamidbar 19:2) fara adumma temima asher en bah mum asher lo ala aleha ol, asur lacharosh beshabbat charisha bashshor. deittemar (Tehillim 129:3) al gabbi charshu chorshim. ushechinta tattaa ihi para aduma missitra digvura. temima, missitra dechesed, deihu darga deavraham, deittemar beh (Bereshit 17:1) hithallech lefanay vehye tamim. asher en bah mum, missitra deammuda deemtzaita. asher lo ala aleha ol, missitra dishchinta illaa deihi cheru, baatar deihi shalta (Bamidbar 1:nusach acher) vehazzar hakkarev yumat, let reshu lesitra achara leshalletaa, lo satan, velo mashchit, velo malach hammavt, deinnun missitra degehinnam.

Uvegin da, beyomin dechol, amrin yisrael, (Tehillim 78:38) vehu rachum yechapper avon velo yashchit vehirba lehashiv appo vegomer. begin divyomin dechol, shechinta tattaa itlabbeshat beillen kelifin demita dedina. uveshabbat itpashshetat minnayyhu, begin deilana dechayye deihu ben 14, 20, itchabbar beHei. behahu zimna nayycha ishtechachat lehe, vechol ma deihu techotah, vela tzarich lememar beh vehu rachum. uman innun (sefer acher techotah). techot 10 yisrael. vechol atar deyisrael mishtakkechin, netiru ishtechach venayycha.

Uvegin da, asur limecherash beara, ulemebad bah gumot, dahavi keillu avid pegimu beara kaddisha, deihi shechinta. veasur leishtammesha bechelim deara beshabbat. vaafillu letaltel even. vela keli bealma. dihevi nayycha lon bizchu dishchinta deitkeriat avna, dichtiv bah (Bereshit 28:22) vehaeven hazzot asher samti matztzeva, bitzlota. amida ihi leyisrael, divginah it lon kiuma bealma. vealeh ittemar, (Bereshit 49:24) mishsham roe even yisrael. (Zecharya 3:9) al even achat shiva enayim, (Tehillim 118:22) even maasu habbonim.

Uvegin da (Shemot 31:16) veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat laasot et hashshabbat ledorotam berit olam. tzarich lenatra lah bediratam, dela yippekun mershut hayyachid lershut harabbim. vehay ihu deukemuha mare matnitin, yetziot hashshabbat shetayim shehen
1518: Arba, hotzaa mershut lirshut, vehachenasa name yetzia kare lah. veinnun samael venachash, tzerichin yisrael lenatra lon, dela yelun ledira dishchinta, deihi reshut hayyachid. man reshut harabbim. chalala shifcha zona nidda goya, reshut desamael venachash, veshivin memanan deammin. (ad kan raya mehemana)

Patach veamar, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:1) bati leganni vechulei, ad chelve chaser. nidpas befarashat Vayikra daf 3 amud bet. uvechibbura kadmaa, (baddaf 241 amud alef) ariti mori im besami, deroa yemina beyarcha semala. achalti yari im divshi, yaakov berachel. shatiti yeni im chalavi, deroa semala beyarcha yemina. deroa yemina beyarcha semala, innun chesed im hod. yaakov berachel, ammuda deemtzaita bammalchut. deroa semala beyarcha yemina gevura benetzach.

Vaamay shene middot dileh hachi. ella raza denema hacha, david amar hacha, (Tehillim 132:9) kohanecha yilbeshu tzedek vachasidecha yerannenu. veittemar hatam, uleviyyecha mibbae leh lememar. amar kudesha berich hu lav orach leshannot middotay, ella batar dezammenat li, it li lemebad reutach. umehacha olifna, devaal havayit dimzammin afillu lemalka, it leh lemebad reuteh. uvegin da okmuha, kol ma sheomer lach baal habbayit ase chutz mitztze. veim kol da deraza da shappir ihu, ha ketiv (Malachi 3:6) ani Adonai lo shaniti, uvechol karbenin la ketiv behon ella laydod, ech yachil lemehevi diyyeshanne dargin dishmeh bekarbena.

Ella, ariti mori: yotzer or. im besami: ahavat olam. achalti yari: shema yisrael. im divshi: baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed. shatiti yeni: vehaya im shamoa, ad vayyomer. im chalavi: min vayyomer, ad emet. ichlu reim: 3 rishonot, veg acharonot. shetu veshichru dodim: shear birchan ditzlota.

Uvechibbura kadmaa, sitra dekarbena, parim uchevasim veattudim veizzim, innun 4, pene shor. pene nesher vegomer, shete torim o shene bene yona, vetzarich lefarsha. arye nachit legave shor, deihu semala, leitkashshera chesed bigvura. adam nachit legabbe nesher. darga deyaakov. uvegin da okmuha mare matnitin, shufereh deyaakov shufereh deadam kadmaa hava. uman garim leistalleka leitkere yisrael, dichtiv, (Bereshit 32:29) lo yaakov yeamer od shimcha ki im yisrael yihye shemecha, dihevi yisrael ikkar leafresha benayyhu. (ad kan raya mehemana) (247 amud alef uvechibbura kadmaa savelat lemincha vechulei).

(Bamidbar 28:5) vaasirit haefa, amay. ella asirit haefa, lokovel keneset yisrael. deihi ashiraa dedargin, veitztericha leityayhava ben teren deroin, veihi solet nahama, veihi nahama. uvegin deihi nahama, la itpekad al nahama dachameshet minin, deihi chitta, useora, veshifon vechulei, memana dealma. vela shavvi memana alayyhu, ella kudesha berich hu bilchodoy.

Uvegin da, man dimzalzel benahama, vezarik leh beara, aniyyuta radif abbatreh. vechad memana itpekad al da, veihu radif abbatreh, lemehav leh aniyyuta, vela yippuk min alma, ad deyitzterich labbiryayn. vealeh ketiv, (Iyov 15:23) noded hu lallechem ayye. noded hu, veyehach mittaltel, vegalle meatar laatar, lallechem ayye hu. velet
1519: Man deyashgach aleh, hada hu dichtiv ayye. man diyrachem aleh, begin dela yishkach. (uvechibbura kadmaa amar raya mehemana man damezalezalea)

Raya mehemna uvechibbura kadmaa amar raya mehemana, man dimzalzil befirurin denahama, vezarik lon baatar dela itztzetrich. hay kol shekken man dimzalzel befirurin democha, deinnun tippin dezera, dezarik lon beara, deittemar behon (Bereshit 6:12) ki hishchit kol basar et darko al haaretz. o dezarik lon benidda, o bevat el nechar, o beshifcha o bezona. vekol shekken vekol shekken man dimzalzel befirurin denahama deorayyta, deinnun kotztze atvavn, vetage atvavn, deittemar alayyhu kol hammishtammesh betaga cholaf.

Kol shekken man demasar razin deorayyta, vesitre kabbala, vesitre maase bereshit, o sitre atvavn dishma meforash, laanashim delav innun hagunim, deshalit alayyhu yetztzer hara, isha zona, deittemar alah, (Mishlei 6:26) ki bead ishsha zona ad kikkar lachem. velet lechem ella 22 atvavn deorayyta. velet kikkar, ella afillu halacha achat. (veod raya mehemana)

Uvechibbura kadmaa, la galle raza beillen pirurin, ella beorach peshat, vela yahiv behon shiura. aval okmuha mare matnitin, deshiura defirurin kazzayit lefachot, kol shekken i innun kabbetztza. demare matnitin dikdeku alayyhu, ad kazzayit ad kabbetztza levarcha alayyhu.

Veorach raza, 9 hu 9 pirurin, shalosh lechol setar, telat min 4, teren asar. reviit ihu shelimu, leashlema beh eser. uleashlema 4, deinnun yedod. may eser. innun: yod hei vav hei. kotztza deat 4 min echad, shiura kazzayit. 10 min yedod, shiura dileh kabbetztza.

Ihi 4, shelimu demerkavta deadam, ushelimu dearba anpin deadam. uvegin da, (Bamidbar 6:25) yisa yedod panav elecha. veokmuha mare matnitin, vehachtiv (Devarim 10:17) asher lo yissa fanim. ella amar hakkadosh baruch hu, velo amarti lahem (Devarim 11:15) veachalta veshovata, vehem dikdeku alehem, ad kazzayit o ad kabbetztza, veech lo essa lahem panim. verabbanan dematnitin vaamorain, kol talmuda dilhon, al razin deorayyta sidderu leh.

Kam raya mehemana, vesalik yedoy kamme kudesha berich hu ushechinteh, veamar hachi, kudesha berich hu yehe raava dilach, lemehav lon mezona shelemata, letakkena legabbach, ulegabbe matronita illaa alma deate, deittemar alah, (Tehillim 22:29) ki laAdonai hammelucha umoshel baggoyim. ulegabbe matronita tinyayna, deittemar bah zimna tinyayna, (Ovadya 1:21) vehayta laAdonai hammelucha. letakkena patora shelemata, michol iddunin, umikkol maachalin.

Vaana mezammen imach, lechol mare matnitin, ulemare mikra, ulemare talmud, vekol shekken lemare sitre tora dilach, kalla dilach, matronita kadisha dilach, illaa vetattaa, vecholla birshut deillat kol illain, adon kol haadonim, melech al kol hammelachim deella vetatta, deihu yachid bela tinyayna, velet at unekuda demishtattef bahadeh, vela shinnuy gavvnin deenasha. deihu mare kol maftechan, derazin dehavavyvt, ushemahan vechinnuyin, vechol razin genizin dechachmeta, detiftach lon kullehu likara dilach, illat al kol illot. ana mitchannen kodamach, detiftach lon likara dilach, diykara dilach ihu meavi veimmi dishmayya, veav dechol yisrael, veem dilhon, deittemar bah (Mishlei 1:8-9) veal titosh torat immecha, veimmach let shuttafu deem bealma.

Kam zimna tinyayna, veamar mare matnitin, nishmatin veruchin venafshin dilchon, ataru kean kulehu, veabaru shenata minnechon, deihi vadday mishna, orach peshat dehay alma. daana la atarna bachu, ella berazin illain dealma deate, deattun behon (Tehillim 121:4) hinne lo yanum velo yishan.

Patach veamar, ha okmuha mare matnitin, baal habbayit botztzea veoreach mevarech. veod okmuha, tzarich ledakdek baAdonai min hammotztzi. uteren hehin innun, lokovel shete hallechem. shete kikkarot deshabbat. 10, ihi kabbetztza lechol chad vechad. uman ihu baal habbayit devotztzea. da 6.

Addehachi, ha sava desavin ka nachit legabbeh, veamar, raya mehemana chazor bach. deha lechem ihu 6, shete kikkarot dileh, kema deamrat innun Adonai Adonai. vadday 6 ihu lokovel yaakov. Adonai Adonai lokovel lea verachel. 10, kabbetztza lechol chad.

Amar leh, sava sava, veha bechamma atrin ukemuha, deyaakov ihu baal havayit, veyosef oreach, dedargeh yesod chay almin, kalil 18 birchan ditztzelota, uvegin da okmuha aleh, (Mishlei 10:6) berachot lerosh tzaddik. amar leh hachi hu, vecholla keshot. kol raza beatreh, ma daana amarit, uma deat amart. aval hahu defalig nahama man hu.

Amar leh, sava ant bediukeneh, veda yod hei vav hei, veda adam demerkavta illaa, deanpin dileh Adonai. uvegin da, 6 lechem, deinnun Adonai Adonai. veshiura deukemuha kazzayit vechabbetztza, ha ittemar kazzayit bean shema meshaarin, deha ukemuha rabbanan deen osin mitztzevot chavilot, uf hachi, la yahavenan teren shiurin beat 10, lemehevi kazzayit vechabbetztza. ella tere alfa betot innun, it 10 illaa, veit 10 zeera, 10 min yedod, illaa. 10 min adonay, zeera. veillen teren, chad bechazzayit, vechad bechabbetztza, beraza da yeahdonahy. ata sava venashik leh.

Addehachi kam butztzina kadisha, patach veamar, vadday kean mitchabberin (Mishlei 30:4) ma shemo uma shem beno, chadu chavrayyay veamru, zakkaa hu man dezache lemechal mehay nahama, deittemar beh (Mishlei 9:Adonai) lechu lachamu belachmi. vezakkaa nafsha, deittemar bah (Vayikra 22:13) millechem aviha tochel. (Vayikra 22:13) vechol zar lo ychal bo. dekudesha berich hu beh ittemar, (Malachi 2:10) halo av echad lechullanu. venafsha deitaskat beorayyta, millechem aviha tochel.
Uman garim lah deachlat millechem aviha. begin detavat betiyyuveta
